title: Leader, EMEA Product Support
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Leader, EMEA Product Support role manages Benchling support in EMEA. As the team leader (a player-coach role), you’ll manage Product Support Analalyts in Europe and spend roughly 40% of your time directly owning customer issues and our most complex escalations. This role owns live customer-impacting incidents for enterprise pharma and biotech customers, helps shape an AI-first support model, and sits close to CX leadership. Working closely with our Global Support and CX Leadership Teams, you’ll combine team leadership, incident management, and thoughtful AI adoption to help scale a modern, efficient Support organization. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and coach your team: run daily regional support operations including prioritization and resourcing, hold regular team meetings and career growth conversations, and build a culture where people feel supported and excited to grow.

  • Partner with the Incident Center of Excellence to mature the incident process (post-incident reviews, closing action items, communication playbooks, severity-based response criteria), and help build and run a sustainable off-hours coverage model, including personally rotating in as an escalation responder.

  • Analyze support metrics (volume, severity trends, time-to-resolution, comms timeliness) to inform staffing and process decisions, and report trends to CX leadership.

  • Drive consistent adoption of AI tools across support workflows, piloting ways to reduce ticket-handling time, surface account context automatically, and free up analyst time for higher-value work.

  • Collaborate with Build, Product, Technical Account Managers, Customer Success, and Professional Services on customer issues and incidents, keep help content and product knowledge current, and represent support at customer-facing events as needed.

  • Work the queue alongside your team: own complex, high-priority, and escalated tickets, serve as a first-line contact for regional escalations, and model the troubleshooting, investigation, and communication standards you expect from others.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experienced leader who coaches with empathy and stays close to the work, with 1+ years of management experience and 5+ years of SaaS support or professional services, or demonstrated leadership, including assigning ticket work and managing queues and resources. Able to personally troubleshoot and resolve complex customer issues.

  • Working knowledge of support and incident tooling and best practices for technical support environments (e.g. Salesforce, Zendesk, JIRA, PagerDuty, or equivalent), plus genuine enthusiasm for AI in support, ideally with hands-on experience piloting or driving adoption.

  • Sound judgment under pressure: prioritizing by urgency, severity, and customer health context, and skilled in customer-facing crisis communication, including what to say, when, and to whom during a live incident, and how to translate root cause into clear RCAs/ISNs.

  • Experience with enterprise-grade support: managing high-stakes accounts holistically, building trust with sophisticated customers, and thinking beyond individual ticket resolution.

  • Strong communicator and customer advocate with a bias toward action, comfortable working independently across departments, remote teams, and external stakeholders. Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences related field recommended (biology, microbiology, genetics, biotechnology, neurology, etc.); research or lab experience is a big plus.

  • Based in the Zurich area, or willing to relocate, and able to work on-site in our Zurich office Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.

     

HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences.

We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

title: Backend Software Developer
description:
Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.

Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en de NPO met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.

Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Backend Software Developer. Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers.

Jouw rol

Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je bent analytisch sterk en je krijgt er energie van om technische requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren die je vervolgens zélf bouwt. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie.

Wat je zal gaan doen:

  • Ontwikkelen en operationeel maken van serverless backends en event-driven API's met TypeScript (AWS Lambda / Serverless Functions).

  • Zelfstandig opzetten van cloud-infrastructuren met behulp van Infrastructure as Code (bijv. via AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation).

  • Proactief meedenken over en het inrichten van CI/CD pipelines, applicatie-uptime en databeveiliging.

  • Bijdragen aan de codekwaliteit door middel van code reviews en het actief delen van kennis met jouw teamleden.

  • Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team.


Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties. Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen.

Je bent niet alleen een developer, maar je kunt ook écht zelf cloudomgevingen operationeel krijgen en beheren met tools als AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation. Algemene cloud kennis is een vereiste; specifieke ervaring met AWS of Scaleway is een pre. Je geniet van technische puzzels, levert graag goed geteste code op en voelt je thuis in een Node.js backend. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • Maatschappelijke Impact: De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, Pathé Thuis en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper).

  • Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6000,- passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten.

  • Werkplek & Sfeer: Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen.

  • Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken: Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen.

  • Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies.

  • De 'Gadget Kit': Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek.

  • Events & Fun: Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.

Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen software ontwikkeling) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen.

title: Sr. Coordinator, Individualized Care
description:
Cardinal Health Sonexus™ Access and Patient Support helps specialty pharmaceutical manufacturers remove barriers to care so that patients can access, afford and remain on the therapy they need for a better quality of life. Our diverse expertise in pharma, payer and hub services allows us to deliver best-in-class solutions—driving brand and patient markers of success. We’re continuously integrating advanced and emerging technologies to streamline patient onboarding, qualification and adherence. Our non-commercial specialty pharmacy is centralized at our custom-designed facility outside of Dallas, Texas, empowering manufacturers to rethink the reach and impact of their products.


Together, we can get life-changing therapies to patients who need them—faster.

Delivering an exclusive model that fully integrates direct drug distribution to site-of-care with non-commercial pharmacy services, patient access support, and financial programs, Sonexus Health, a subsidiary of Cardinal Health, helps specialty pharmaceutical manufacturers have a greater connection to the customer experience and better control of product success. Personalized service and creative solutions executed through a flexible technology platform means providers are more confident in prescribing drugs, patients can more quickly obtain and complete therapy, and manufacturers can directly access more actionable insight than ever before. With all services centralized in our custom-designed facility outside of Dallas, Texas, Sonexus Health helps manufacturers rethink how far their products can go.

Responsibilities

  • First point of contact on inbound calls and determines needs and handles accordingly
  • Creates and completes accurate applications for enrollment with a sense of urgency
  • Scrutinizes forms and supporting documentation thoroughly for any missing information or new information to be added to the database
  • Conducts outbound correspondence when necessary to help support the needs of the patient and/or program
  • Resolve patient's questions and any representative for the patient’s concerns regarding status of their request for assistance
  • Update internal treatment plan statuses and external pharmacy treatment statuses
  • Maintain accurate and detailed notations for every interaction using the appropriate database for the inquiry
  • Self-audit intake activities to ensure accuracy and efficiency for the program
  • Make all outbound calls to patient and/or provider to discuss any missing information and/or benefit related information
  • Notify patients, physicians, practitioners, and or clinics of any financial responsibility of services provided as applicable
  • Assess patient’s financial ability to afford therapy and provide hand on guidance to appropriate financial assistance
  • Follow through on all benefit investigation rejections, including Prior Authorizations, Appeals, etc. All avenues to obtain coverage for the product must be fully exhausted
  • Track any payer/plan issues and report any changes, updates, or trends to management
  • Search insurance options and explain various programs to the patient while helping them to select the best coverage option for their situation
  • Handle all escalations based upon region and ensure proper communication of the resolution within required time frame agreed upon by the client
  • Serve as a liaison between client sales force and applicable party
  • Mediate situations in which parties are in disagreement and facilitate a positive outcome
  • Concurrently handle multiple outstanding issues and ensure all items are resolved in a timely manner to the satisfaction of all parties
  • Responsible for reporting any payer issues by region with the appropriate team
  • As needed conduct research associated with issues regarding the payer, physician’s office, and pharmacy to resolve issues swiftly

What is expected of you and others at this level

  • Effectively applies knowledge of job and company policies and procedures to complete a variety of assignments
  • In-depth knowledge in technical or specialty area
  • Applies advanced skills to resolve complex problems independently
  • May modify process to resolve situations
  • Works independently within established procedures; may receive general guidance on new assignments
  • May provide general guidance or technical assistance to less experienced team members

Qualifications

  • Previous customer service experience is required
  • High School diploma or equivalent preferred
  • Patient Support Service experience, preferred
  • Clear knowledge of Medicare (A, B, C, D), Medicaid & Commercial payers policies and guidelines for coverage, preferred
  • Knowledge of DME, MAC practices if preferred
  • Clear understanding of Medical, Supplemental, and pharmacy insurance benefit practices, preferred
  • 1-2 years of Pharmacy and/or Medical Claims billing and Coding work experience
  • 1-2 years experience with Prior Authorization and Appeal submissions
  • Ability to work with high volume production teams with an emphasis on quality
  • Intermediate to advanced computer skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office including but not limited to Word, Outlook and preferred Excel capabilities
  • Previous medical experience is preferred
  • Adaptable and Flexible, preferred
  • Self-Motivated and Dependable, preferred
  • Strong ability to problem solve, preferred
  • Bilingual is preferred

TRAINING AND WORK SCHEDULES: Your new hire training will take place 8:00am-5:00pm CST, mandatory attendance is required.

This position is full-time (40 hours/week). Employees are required to have flexibility to work any of our shift schedules during our normal business hours of Monday-Friday, 7:00am- 7:00pm CST.

REMOTE DETAILS: You will work remotely, full-time. It will require a dedicated, quiet, private, distraction free environment with access to high-speed internet. We will provide you with the computer, technology and equipment needed to successfully perform your job. You will be responsible for providing high-speed internet. Internet requirements include the following:

  • Maintain a secure, high-speed, broadband internet connection (DSL, Cable, or Fiber) at the remote location. Dial-up, satellite, WIFI, Cellular connections are NOT acceptable.
  • Download speed of 15Mbps (megabyte per second)
  • Upload speed of 5Mbps (megabyte per second)
  • Ping Rate Maximum of 30ms (milliseconds)
  • Hardwired to the router
  • Surge protector with Network Line Protection for CAH issued equipment

Anticipated hourly range: $21.40 per hour - $30.60 per hour

Bonus eligible: No

Benefits: Cardinal Health offers a wide variety of benefits and programs to support health and well-being.

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Paid time off plan
  • Health savings account (HSA)
  • 401k savings plan
  • Access to wages before pay day with myFlexPay
  • Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
  • Short- and long-term disability coverage
  • Work-Life resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Healthy lifestyle programs

Application window anticipated to close: 1/19/202

6* if interested in opportunity, please submit application as soon as possible.

The hourly range listed is an estimate. Pay at Cardinal Health is determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s geographical location, relevant education, experience and skills and an evaluation of internal pay equity.

Cardinal Health supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate the power of our differences to create better solutions for our customers by ensuring employees can be their authentic selves each day. Cardinal Health is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, veteran status, marital status, creed, status with regard to public assistance, genetic status or any other status protected by federal, state or local law.

title: Corporate Counsel, Commercial
description:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each memberâs life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries â from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets â including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review â as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity ð

As Corporate Counsel, Commercial, you will be the legal partner behind Carrotâs customer and vendor contracts. Day to day, you will negotiate, draft, and review a high volume of commercial agreements, including master services agreements, service level agreements, professional services agreements, and NDAs. You will partner closely with Sales and other business teams to resolve redlines and customer questions quickly, manage most matters from start to finish, and escalate high-risk issues when the moment calls for it.

This role is built for an attorney who pairs sharp legal judgment with practical business thinking. You will help move deals toward close while managing risk thoughtfully, supporting employers, health plans, and health systems around the world. You will join a collaborative Legal team and have support as you grow into greater independence and take on work with limited oversight.

Â 

What Youâll Own ð¼

In this role, you will:

  • Negotiate, draft, and interpret a wide range of commercial and vendor agreements, managing most contract matters from intake through signature.
  • Partner with Sales and other business teams to resolve redlines and customer questions efficiently and keep deal timelines on track.
  • Provide strategic legal advice to internal client groups, translating legal and regulatory risk into practical business recommendations.
  • Identify and explain operational and revenue-related risks, and escalate high-risk issues at the right time.
  • Manage a high volume of contracts at all times while protecting quality and turnaround speed.
  • Support privacy and data protection terms in commercial agreements, including HIPAA Business Associate Agreements and Data Protection Agreements.
  • Work across a complex, global matrix of collaborators to support Carrotâs growth.
  • Use contract lifecycle management and AI tools to improve the efficiency of legal research, drafting, and contract workflows.

Â 

What Success Looks Like Â ð

In your first 12â18 months, you will have:

  • Independently managed a high volume of commercial contracts from intake to signature with consistently timely turnarounds.
  • Become a trusted legal partner to Sales and other client groups, resolving redlines and customer questions efficiently.
  • Taken on increasingly complex and multi-party agreements with limited oversight.
  • Escalated high-risk issues proactively, with clear recommendations for the business.
  • Built working fluency in Carrotâs products, customer segments, and the global fertility and family-building landscape, and applied it to practical negotiating positions.
  • Improved contract workflows by making full use of Ironclad and AI-enabled tools.




About You â¨

You likely have:

  • A J.D. and membership in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • 3+ years of legal experience, in-house and/or at a law firm, ideally with in-house transactional experience at a health plan or startup.
  • A strong grasp of contracting concepts and solid experience drafting, negotiating, and interpreting commercial and vendor agreements such as MSAs, SLAs, professional services agreements, and NDAs.
  • Experience counseling a sales organization.
  • The ability to analyze and advise on legal and regulatory risk, with creative solutions that support growth.
  • Flexibility, a willingness to work on a broad variety of legal matters, and comfort with ambiguity.
  • A record of strategic thinking and of working across a complex matrix of global collaborators, pairing strong legal analysis with practical business recommendations.

Â 

Nice to Have â­

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts with global companies.
  • Experience with complex multi-party commercial agreements and vendor agreement review.
  • Hands-on experience with contract lifecycle management software, especially Ironclad.
  • Experience using AI tools.
  • Knowledge of privacy laws including HIPAA, CCPA, and GDPR in the context of BAAs and DPAs.
  • Interest in fertility and reproductive health policy, and how it differs by country and culture.
  • Knowledge of the employee benefits, healthcare, and/or pharmaceutical industries.

Â 

Why This Role Matters ð§¡

Carrotâs contracts are how our mission reaches people. Every agreement with an employer, health plan, or health system shapes how well members around the world can access fertility and family-building care. In this role, you help Carrot say yes to growth in ways that protect the company, our customers, and the members we serve.

Because you will own most matters from beginning to end, your judgment directly affects deal velocity, customer trust, and revenue. You will be a visible, trusted partner to Sales and the broader business while helping a rapidly growing global company scale its commercial legal function.



Interview Process ð¤

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen â 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview â 30â45 minutes
  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews â 45 minutes
  4. Executive Leadership Conversation â 30 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Â 

Why Candidates Join Carrot ð

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Â 

Â 

Compensationð°

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support you in all aspects of life, inside and outside of work. Our benefits include comprehensive health and wellness coverage, retirement savings plans, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. This role is:

Base + equity roles:
Compensation for this role is structured as base salary plus equity, giving you ownership in Carrot's long-term growth. This role does not include an annual bonus or variable compensation.

  • Base Salary Range:Â  $140,000-$160,000
  • Geo-Tier Adjustment: ForÂ highly experienced candidates within 50 miles of San Francisco, NYC, or Seattle.

Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.



Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

Â 

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirementâand we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcareâs Innovators. Carrotâs global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortuneâs Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. title: Private Practice Enablement Specialist (PST)
description:
Our Mission

Healthie is an AI-Native, ONC Certified EHR for modern outpatient healthcare.Â 

Healthie is proud to power clinically excellent healthcare for over 40,000 providers who deliver clinically excellent healthcare - longitudinal and collaboratively, with patient and provider experiences at the center. Both healthcare and technology are undergoing unparalleled industry innovation, and itâs incredible to see the momentum - from consumers, from providers, and from reimbursement for this type of healthcare - grow exponentially.Â 

We provide the powerful infrastructure every care delivery organization needs. On the surface this includes EHR, Scheduling, Engagement, Billing, Data, and much more. Underneath the iceberg are thousands of configurations, settings, widgets, automations, and limitless capabilities because we are an API-first platform. Our fully brandable platform makes it easy for clinics and organizations of any size to scale and never reach a limit.Â 

Today, over 3 billion API calls are made to Healthie every month, as thousands of organizations who work with more than 21 million patients in total, rely on Healthie to deliver clinically excellent healthcare in over 35 specialties, from behavioral healthcare to complex chronic care management and personalized medicine.

We believe in the power of technology to improve access to healthcare and weâre building the rails that make this a reality. We work fast and with quality because we provide business-critical, healthcare-critical software that clinicians and patients need for a better healthcare system. Weâre customer-obsessed, operate with lightning-fast processes and responses, and always share our product roadmap publicly-Â  so customers can see what weâre building, and remain relentlessly focused on how care gets delivered.

Healthie is backed by leading investors, and while we've $42M raised to date, more importantly, we operate with fiscal responsibility and have been profitable for more than half of our time as a company. We know that building an ONC-Certified EHR is a lifetimeâs body of work, and we are here to build for our customers forever.

Learn more at https://www.gethealthie.com/

About the role

Weâre hiring a Customer Success Manager to join our Private Practice Enablement team and help customers get the most out of Healthie throughout their entire journey with us. Youâll work with private practices and growing healthcare organizationsâsome brand new to Healthie, others who have been with us for years.

This is a highly customer-facing role centered around understanding how practices operate and helping them use Healthie to accomplish their goals. Youâll build relationships with healthcare executives, practice managers, providers, and clinical champions, becoming a trusted resource as their workflows, teams, and needs evolve.

Our ideal hire is curious, resourceful, and a natural educator. You enjoy learning how different healthcare organizations work, can turn complex questions into clear next steps, and are excited to develop the product expertise needed to help customers use Healthie successfully.

About the work

  • Youâll spend much of your day connecting directly with customers through live 1:1 calls and email, helping with everything from initial setup and training to workflow optimization, feature adoption, and new needs that emerge as their practices grow.
  • Youâll learn how customers deliver care, understand their operational and patient care goals, and use deep product knowledge to recommend workflows that make Healthie work for their organization.
  • Youâll solve problems in real time. Sometimes thereâs a straightforward answer; other times youâll need to investigate, think creatively, test different approaches, or bring in the right people to find a solution.
  • Youâll create personalized resources, screen recordings, and examples when showing a customer how to accomplish something is more helpful than simply telling them.
  • Youâll manage multiple customer conversations and priorities at once, adapting your communication and approach to different practices, personalities, and challenges.
  • Youâll collaborate with Support, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing, sharing what youâre learning from customers and helping improve our product, resources, processes, and overall customer experience.


Details, details

  • This is a full-time, remote position and U.S. work authorization is required.
  • This job is Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm PST.Â 
  • Weâre seeking fluent English speakers/writers.
  • The salary range is $93,000 - $102,500

About you

Youâve done this kind of work before. Weâre looking for someone with 3â5 years of experience in Customer Success or similar customer-facing role. And it is a requirement that you've worked at a software company. Bonus points if youâve worked in healthcare technology, or have experience working with private practices or growing healthcare organizations.

  • Youâre comfortable independently leading customer conversations and building relationships with everyone from individual providers to practice managers and healthcare leaders. You ask thoughtful questions, listen closely, and know how to adapt your approach to the person in front of you.
  • Youâre a natural educator and an excellent communicator. You can take complicated products, workflows, and questions and turn them into clear, practical next steps. We value good writers.
  • Youâre curious about how customers work. You want to understand what someone is actually trying to accomplish before recommending a solution, and you enjoy learning the different ways healthcare organizations operate and deliver care.
  • Youâre a strong problem-solver with good judgment. When there isnât an obvious answer, youâre comfortable researching, testing different approaches, and using the resources around you to figure out the best path forward.
  • Youâre organized and self-directed. You can manage customer calls, emails, follow-ups, and projects simultaneously, take ownership of whatâs in front of you, and recognize when something needs another perspective or team.
  • Youâre good at navigating challenging conversations. You can set expectations, explain limitations, and provide thoughtful guidance even when the answer isnât exactly what a customer hoped to hear.
  • You have plenty of tech skills, and you're confident working across a variety of tools and apps, and can troubleshoot everyday issues on your ownâthings like browser quirks, connectivity problems, login hiccups, and mobile device settings.
  • Youâre a collaborative teammate and strong customer advocate. You share what youâre learning, give helpful and direct feedback, and bring patterns from customer conversations back to the broader team so we can continue improving how we support our customers and build Healthie.

How to applyÂ 

Please submit a PDF cover letter and introduce yourself. Include:

  • Tell us who you are and why you want this job at Healthie.
  • Where are you based and what time zone are you in?
  • Why do you want to work in Customer Success?

In your cover letter, answer these real-world customer scenarios. Reply to the customer directly like you would if you worked on our Private Practice team. Also tell us how youâd approach the conversation, and explain your thinking for each reply.Â 

  • A customer recently signed up for Healthie and is excited to get started. They want to go live as soon as possible and have an upcoming appointment with a client. They need help manually adding the client to Healthie and sending them an invitation to access the platform.

  • A customer who has been using Healthie for several years reaches out because their practice has grown and their current workflow is no longer working well for their team. They have a specific idea for how theyâd like to solve the problem, but you arenât sure whether Healthie can support exactly what theyâre asking for.Â 

Interview Process

  • Quick chat with our Talent team (15 minutes)
  • Interview with Talita, Private Practice Team Lead (30 minutes)
  • Interview with Justin, VP of Customer Support (30 minutes)
  • Live demo with Talita and Jen (30 minutes)
    • Youâll be asked to give us a brief product demo. Youâll share your screen and show us how to add a client and schedule an appointment.Â 
  • Final session with Talita and Justin (30 minutes)
  • Reference checks

title: Intake and Discharge Clinician
description:
At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Intake and Discharge Clinician to join our Virtual Intensive Outpatient Program (vIOP)Â team. This role would be responsible for conducting comprehensive clinical intake and level-of-care assessments, developing individualized treatment plans, setting expectations and facilitating warm handoffs into the appropriate program, and supporting patients through discharge and transition to the next appropriate level of care. We are looking for someone who has experience supporting patient intake and discharge/step-down coordination and wants to bring their talents into a âfor purposeâ space. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position with a schedule of Monday - Friday w/ rotating Saturdays 9a-5p -or- Tuesday-Saturday 9a-5p Eastern or Central (depending on where the clients live) Time.

What Youâll Do

Intake & Level-of-Care Assessment

    • Conduct comprehensive virtual intake assessments for patients transitioning from the UHS system into the Virtual IOP.
    • Review, summarize, and extract key information provided by the UHS discharge planner, including clinical recommendations, authorized days, and recommended program track.
    • Collect and ensure that patient location and emergency contact/service information is up to date.Â Â 
    • Conduct comprehensive level-of-care assessments to confirm appropriate level of care and program placement, including but not limited to biopsychosocial assessment, DSM-5 diagnostic evaluation, Mental Status Examination (MSE), C-SSRS suicide risk assessment, PHQ-9, GAD-7, medical and medication review, and substance use screening.
    • Develop an individualized treatment plan based on assessment findings and identified treatment goals.
    • Review and update safety plan provided by UHS discharge planner.

Patient TransitionÂ Â 

    • Conduct a warm handoff with the patient following completion of the intake assessment.
    • Review the recommended treatment plan, program expectations, and next steps with the patient.
    • Coordinate transition into care by scheduling the patient for their psychiatry intake, agreed-upon Virtual IOP program, weekly therapy, and medication managementÂ  appointments.
    • Communicate relevant clinical information and recommendations to appropriate members of the care team to support continuity of care.

Ongoing Clinical Assessment & Documentation

    • Complete weekly C-SSRS assessments for patients with identified suicidal ideation or suicide risk.
    • Complete and document MSE as part of individual therapy sessions and, when appropriate, within the individual section of group notes.
    • Maintain timely, accurate, and clinically appropriate documentation within the designated platform in accordance with organizational policies and regulatory timelines.Â 
    • Monitor patient progress and identify changes in clinical presentation that may require reassessment of level of care or treatment recommendations.

Discharge & Step-Down Planning

    • Review treatment team meeting notes and confirm and record discharge status.
    • Conduct discharge assessments and support patients in transitioning from the Virtual IOP to the next appropriate level of care.
    • Coordinate step-down recommendations, which may include an outpatient level of care, outpatient group programming, continued individual therapy, or another appropriate treatment setting.
    • Coordinate step-up recommendations, which may include partial hospitalization program, inpatient hospitalization, residential treatment facility, or other appropriate treatment setting.Â 
    • Provide patients with clear recommendations and support for their transition out of the program.
    • Coordinate with vIOP Psychiatrist to ensure discharge documentation is approved and signed off.Â 
    • Coordinate with relevant internal and external stakeholders, as appropriate, to support continuity of care following discharge.
    • Reassess level of care needs when clinically indicated and escalate concerns to appropriate clinical leadership.

Risk & Crisis Control

    • Identify and mitigate immediate safety threats, stabilize, and document in accordance with risk protocol and guidelines.Â 

Team MeetingsÂ 

    • Be an active participant and problem solver in recurrent meetings.

Performs other related duties as assigned.

About YouÂ 

  • Must hold an active, unrestricted independent clinical license in TX or FL
  • Strong clinical judgment, timely documentation skills, and ability to effectively communicate with patients and care team members
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, virtual clinical environment
  • Experience with Intensive Outpatient Programs (IOP), Partial Hospitalization Programs (PHP), behavioral health, or virtual care preferred
  • Strong clinical knowledge of assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning, risk assessment, level of care determination, and patient safety
  • Access to a private, HIPAA-compliant workspace
  • Experience working with clinical providers and multidisciplinary teams

Bonus Points

  • Experience with virtual healthcare delivery or digital health platforms preferred

BenefitsÂ 

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans
  • Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA
  • 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 3%
  • Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.
  • 160 hours of PTO per year
  • Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events
  • Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!Â 

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $80,000/yr and $95,000/yr. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidateâs relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.Â 

Why Talkspace?Â 

Talkspace is the worldâs leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the worldâs population â 2 billion people â live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind âgetting help,â we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverseÂ  âfor purposeâ space. If youâre equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you donât meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional â such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record â if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?Â 

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

title: Compliance Officer/MLRO
description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the worldâs leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 â connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Â 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Â 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Role Purpose

Lead the establishment and ongoing oversight of the Pakistan entityâs independent Compliance function and Anti-Money Laundering, Counter-Terrorist Financing and Counter-Proliferation Financing (AML/CFT/CPF) framework.
During the pre-licensing phase, the role holder will lead Compliance-owned licensing deliverables, develop the local control framework and assess operational readiness. Following licensing, the role holder will discharge the entityâs CO/MLRO responsibilities, advise the Board and senior management, and maintain effective engagement with PVARA, the Financial Monitoring Unit (FMU) and other relevant authorities.
The role combines CO and MLRO responsibilities, subject to applicable regulatory requirements and any required regulatory acceptance or approval. The suitability of the combined arrangement will be reviewed periodically, considering independence, conflicts, capacity, resources and the entityâs nature, scale and complexity.
Â 

Key Responsibilities

  1. Licensing and Operational Readiness
  • Lead Compliance-owned components of the PVARA licensing application and coordinate relevant inputs from Legal, Business, Risk, Finance, Operations and Technology.
  • Develop and maintain a regulatory obligations register, licensing deliverables tracker and local implementation roadmap.
  • Assess gaps between group policies, systems and controls and applicable Pakistan requirements; oversee localisation and track remediation.
  • Establish local Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF policies, governance arrangements, escalation procedures and regulatory reporting processes.
  • Define local control requirements for customer onboarding, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, Travel Rule compliance and suspicious transaction reporting.
  • Assess the suitability and readiness of local, group-provided and outsourced controls, including relevant pre-launch testing.
  • Provide a documented Compliance and AML readiness assessment to the appropriate governance forum, escalating unresolved material gaps before launch.
Â 
  1. Compliance Oversight
  • Establish, administer and maintain a documented, risk-based Compliance Management System (CMS) proportionate to the entityâs activities and risk profile.
  • Advise the Board, relevant committees and senior management on applicable legal and regulatory requirements, licence conditions and regulatory developments.
  • Develop and execute a risk-based Compliance Monitoring and Testing Plan; document findings, agree remediation ownership and deadlines with accountable functions, independently validate closure, and escalate overdue or inadequate remediation.
  • Oversee compliance with applicable conduct, customer protection, complaints-handling, client-asset and market-integrity requirements, according to the entityâs licensed activities.
  • Review proposed products, services and material business changes from a local compliance perspective, identifying requirements, restrictions and necessary controls.
  • Ensure material non-compliance is investigated, promptly escalated and remediated, and notified to PVARA where required.
  • Maintain regulatory submission and commitment trackers, overseeing timely and accurate Compliance-owned responses and escalating dependency risks.
  • Act as the primary Compliance liaison with PVARA for supervisory engagement, inspections and information requests.
  • Develop and oversee Compliance training for employees, senior management and relevant key individuals.
Â 
  1. AML/CFT/CPF and Financial Crime
  • Establish, implement and maintain the entityâs AML/CFT/CPF framework, aligned with applicable Pakistan legislation, regulatory requirements and relevant directions or guidance.
  • Lead the enterprise-wide financial crime risk assessment and oversee risk-based mitigation measures.
  • Oversee customer due diligence, beneficial ownership identification, customer risk assessment, enhanced due diligence and ongoing monitoring.
  • Oversee transaction monitoring, sanctions screening and targeted financial sanctions controls, including escalation and action on relevant alerts.
  • Oversee virtual asset-specific controls, including blockchain analytics, risks associated with unhosted wallets and Travel Rule compliance where applicable.
  • Receive and assess internal suspicious activity referrals, determine whether external reporting is required, and submit suspicious transaction reports to the FMU within applicable deadlines.
  • Exercise independent judgement on suspicious transaction reporting without requiring business approval, while maintaining confidentiality and preventing tipping-off.
  • Manage the entityâs FMU/goAML registration, access arrangements and reporting processes, as applicable.
  • Ensure required customer, transaction and investigation records are retained for applicable periods and remain accessible and retrievable.
  • Liaise with the FMU and other competent authorities on financial crime matters and oversee relevant information requests.
  • Oversee AML/CFT/CPF training and awareness, tailored to employeesâ responsibilities and exposure to risk.
Â 
  1. Governance, Reporting and Control Assurance
  • Provide periodic reports to the Board or designated committee on Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF effectiveness, material risks, incidents, findings and remediation progress.
  • Escalate urgent or material matters promptly rather than waiting for scheduled reporting.
  • Attend relevant Board and committee meetings and provide independent advice and challenge.
  • Assess and oversee group-provided and outsourced Compliance/AML services, including local regulatory suitability, service standards, data access, management information and escalation arrangements.
  • Oversee delegated Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF activities and remain accountable for discharging the CO/MLRO responsibilities, without displacing the responsibilities of the entity, Board, senior management or operational control owners.
  • Coordinate with Risk and Internal Audit, while preserving the distinction between Compliance oversight and independent audit assurance.
  • Support periodic review of the role holderâs continuing fitness, propriety and suitability, including the required review of the MLRO appointment.
  • Maintain effective handover and suitably qualified cover arrangements for absences, consistent with applicable regulatory requirements.
Â 

Qualifications and Experience

Essential
  • A degree in law, finance, business or a related discipline, or an equivalent relevant professional qualification.
  • At least eight yearsâ relevant Compliance and/or AML/CFT experience in financial services, including at least three years in a senior Compliance, MLRO or equivalent leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of Pakistanâs financial regulatory and AML/CFT framework, including the Virtual Assets Act, applicable PVARA regulations, the Anti-Money Laundering Act and FMU reporting requirements.
  • Demonstrable understanding of virtual asset business models and their financial crime, conduct and operational risks.
  • Practical experience with customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, investigations and suspicious transaction reporting.
  • Experience developing risk assessments, policies, monitoring programmes and Board-level reporting.
  • Ability to translate regulatory requirements into workable business, operational and technology controls.
  • Be resident in Pakistan by the date of the formal CO/MLRO appointment and maintain residency as required under applicable regulations.
  • Fluency in English and Urdu.
Â 
Desirable
  • Professional certification such as CAMS, an ICA qualification or an equivalent Compliance/AML credential.
  • Experience in virtual assets, exchanges, fintech or digital financial services.
  • Experience supporting a regulatory licence application or establishing a local Compliance function.
  • Experience engaging with PVARA, FMU, SECP, SBP or other relevant Pakistani authorities.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools and Travel Rule solutions.
  • Experience overseeing centralised group services and outsourced control arrangements.
Â 
Key Competencies
  • Independence, integrity and sound judgement.
  • Confidence to challenge senior management constructively.
  • Clear communication with regulators, the Board and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical, investigative and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective prioritisation in a developing regulatory environment.
  • Ability to build a local control framework while working within a global organisation.
Â 
Authority and Independence
  • Direct access to the local Board or designated committee, including the ability to escalate without prior management clearance.
  • Timely and unrestricted access to relevant records, systems, personnel and management information necessary to discharge the role, subject to applicable confidentiality and data-handling requirements.
  • Adequate resources and suitably qualified support proportionate to the entityâs activities and risk profile.
  • No client-facing, sales or other responsibilities that compromise independence, create material conflicts or impair CO/MLRO duties.
  • Remuneration arrangements that do not link the role holderâs performance to sales or revenue targets.
  • Group reporting arrangements that do not restrict local regulatory accountability, Board access or independent MLRO decision-making.
  • Board oversight of appointment, replacement and removal, with regulatory approvals or notifications completed as applicable.
Â 
Regulatory Appointment Conditions
The role holder must satisfy applicable fitness and propriety, residency, employment, competence and regulatory appointment requirements at appointment and on an ongoing basis. Any required PVARA approval, acceptance or notification must be completed in accordance with the applicable framework.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.Â 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

title: Founder's Associate / Business Operations (m/w/d) – 100% Remote weltweit
description:
Remote von überall auf der Welt, direkt an der Seite von zwei Gründern, die schon über 20 Firmen aufgebaut haben.

Über uns

Wir bauen Firmen um Menschen herum, die eine gute Idee haben und sie selbst vorantreiben wollen. Unsere beiden Gründer sind Venture-Architekten: Sie bringen Kapital, Vertrieb, Administration und die richtigen Leute zusammen, die Gründer der neuen Firmen bringen Idee und Antrieb. So sind schon über 20 Firmen entstanden, von Pet-Tech über E-Commerce und Einkaufsdienstleistungen bis zu Software für Anwälte. Zusammen beschäftigt die Gruppe weltweit eine dreistellige Zahl an Mitarbeitern.

Unser Ziel ist eine Maschine, die aus jeder guten Idee eine erfolgreiche Firma macht, die ohne die beiden läuft. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die diese Maschine mit aufbaut. Von wo aus du das tust, ist uns egal.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du machst aus unserer Arbeitsweise Prozesse. Vieles steckt heute in den Köpfen der beiden Gründer: wie wir mit Gründern arbeiten, wie wir Firmen aufsetzen, wie Reporting läuft. Du schaust es dir an, schreibst es auf und baust daraus klare Abläufe.
  • Du baust ein System, über das die Gründer unserer Firmen regelmäßig berichten.
  • Du prüfst neue Ideen am Markt: Du führst viele Kaltakquise-Telefonate, holst ehrliches Feedback ein und hilfst schnell zu entscheiden, ob aus einer Idee eine Firma wird.
  • Du managst die Termine der beiden Gründer und buchst Flüge und Reisen.
  • Du übernimmst Backoffice-Aufgaben, die auf Deutsch erledigt werden müssen.
  • Mit der Zeit wirst du ihre rechte Hand.

Was du mitbringst

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gutes Englisch, weil ein Teil unseres Teams in Indien sitzt
  • Du denkst in Strukturen und machst gern aus Chaos klare Abläufe
  • Mit Fremden zu telefonieren fällt dir leicht, für dich ist es der schnellste Weg zu Antworten
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und brauchst nicht für jeden Schritt eine Anleitung
  • Du gehst sicher mit digitalen Werkzeugen und KI-Tools um
  • Du bist zuverlässig und diskret, denn du bekommst Einblick in viele Firmen

Erfahrung aus einem Startup, einer Beratung oder als Assistenz der Geschäftsführung hilft, ist aber keine Bedingung. Wichtiger als der Lebenslauf sind uns Lernbereitschaft und Motivation.

Was wir bieten

  • 100 % remote, egal wo auf der Welt du lebst
  • Festanstellung in Voll- oder Teilzeit, mit Wohnsitz außerhalb Deutschlands ist auch Freelance möglich

title: Werkstudent KI & Automatisierung (m/w/d)
description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Hi, ich bin Felix Lippe.

Vor ein paar Jahren habe ich Lippe Personal gegründet. Heute sind wir über 25 Leute und eine der führenden Recruiting-Agenturen für medizinische Praxen in Deutschland: Ärzte, Zahnärzte, Physiotherapeuten, Pflege. Wir haben in den letzten Jahren hunderte Praxen betreut und tausende Bewerbungen für unsere Kunden generiert. Das Geschäft läuft.

Und jetzt kommt der Teil, warum ich diese Stelle ausschreibe.

Ich baue das Unternehmen gerade grundlegend um: weg von manueller Arbeit, hin zu einem KI-gesteuerten Unternehmen. Nicht als Buzzword auf der Website, sondern als echtes Projekt, an dem ich täglich selbst arbeite – mit Tools wie Claude Code, n8n und einem eigenen KI-Setup. Ich tausche mich dazu laufend mit externen KI-Agenturen und Experten aus, ich stecke tief im Thema. Was mir fehlt, ist nicht das Wissen und sind nicht die Ideen. Was mir fehlt, ist Zeit und eine rechte Hand, die mit mir baut.

Genau das ist diese Stelle.

Die Rolle: Werkstudent mit Founder-Associate-Charakter

Du arbeitest nicht „bei uns in der IT". Du arbeitest mit mir. Direkt, auf Geschäftsführer-Ebene, ohne Hierarchie-Ebenen dazwischen.

Konkret heißt das: Wir schauen uns gemeinsam an, wo im Unternehmen noch manuell gearbeitet wird, und dann bauen wir das weg. Du bekommst von mir klare Briefings, setzt eigenständig um, und wir sprechen uns in einem festen wöchentlichen Termin ab – oft auch öfter, weil ich Sparring liebe. Du bist bei strategischen Themen dabei, verstehst, warum wir Dinge tun, und siehst, wie ein Unternehmen von innen umgebaut wird. Wenn ich mich mit externen KI-Agenturen und Experten austausche, bekommst du das mit und lernst direkt daraus – genau wie ich.

Das ist der Deal: Du hebelst meine Zeit, ich gebe dir Einblicke und Verantwortung, die du als Werkstudent sonst nirgendwo bekommst.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust mit KI-Tools (vor allem Claude Code) Automatisierungen für unser Tagesgeschäft: Bewerbermanagement, Reporting, Anzeigenerstellung

  • Du optimierst, automatisierst und digitalisierst Prozesse quer durchs Unternehmen – vom Vertrieb bis zum Fulfillment

  • Du setzt Workflows in n8n auf und verbindest unsere Tools miteinander (Airtable, HubSpot, GitHub)

  • Du dokumentierst, was du baust, so dass es als System im Unternehmen bleibt und wächst

  • Du bist mein Sparringspartner: Wir entwickeln gemeinsam weiter, wie dieses Unternehmen in zwei Jahren arbeitet

Was ich dir biete

  • 20 Euro pro Stunde – bewusst am oberen Ende für Werkstudenten in Düsseldorf, weil ich lieber einen richtig Guten habe als drei Mittelmäßige

  • 16 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche, flexibel um deinen Vorlesungsplan herum, in den Semesterferien gerne mehr

  • Nach der Einarbeitung weitgehend Homeoffice. Unser Office in Düsseldorf steht dir jederzeit offen

  • Professionelles KI-Setup ab Tag eins (u. a. Claude Code Max Plan) – du arbeitest mit Tools, die die meisten Unternehmen noch nicht mal kennen

  • Direkter Zugang zu allem, was ich lerne: aus dem Austausch mit KI-Agenturen, Experten und aus unseren eigenen Projekten

  • Echte Verantwortung statt Praktikanten-Aufgaben: Was du baust, läuft danach jeden Tag in einem echten Unternehmen

  • Eine Erfahrung, die dich von praktisch jedem Absolventen abhebt: Du hast nicht über digitale Transformation gelesen, du hast eine mitgebaut

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

Bitte kein klassisches Anschreiben, das liest hier keiner. Stattdessen:

  1. Bewerbung über das Formular – Lebenslauf plus (das ist mir am wichtigsten) ein Link zu irgendetwas, das du gebaut hast: GitHub-Repo, kleines Tool, Automatisierung, Uni-Projekt. Größe egal. Dazu zwei, drei Sätze, was du zuletzt mit KI gelöst hast

  2. Probeaufgabe – wenn deine Bewerbung passt, bekommst du eine kleine Aufgabe (zwei bis drei Stunden Aufwand)

  3. 30-Minuten-Call mit mir – wir lernen uns kennen, du stellst deine Fragen

  4. Entscheidung innerhalb von 48 Stunden. Versprochen

Ich freue mich auf dich.

Felix Lippe
Geschäftsführer, Lippe Personal GmbH


Dein Profil

Ich halte das bewusst offen, weil mir deine Denkweise wichtiger ist als dein Lebenslauf:

  • Du bist eingeschriebener Vollzeit-Student, zum Beispiel in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder etwas Vergleichbarem. Auch andere Studiengänge sind okay, wenn du technisch unterwegs bist

  • Du hast schon mal mit KI-Tools wie Claude Code, Cursor oder ChatGPT etwas Eigenes gebaut oder automatisiert. Muss nichts Großes sein, aber du solltest es zeigen können

  • Begriffe wie Git und Terminal schrecken dich nicht ab

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch: Du fragst nicht „was soll ich tun?", sondern „was bringt uns weiter?"

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und brauchst niemanden, der dir dreimal am Tag über die Schulter schaut

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift

Falls du denkst „ich habe noch nie professionell programmiert": völlig okay. Ich suche keinen fertigen Entwickler. Ich suche jemanden, der mit KI-Tools umgehen kann, Prozesse versteht und Lust hat, mit einem Gründer ein Unternehmen umzubauen. Das ist ein eigenes Handwerk – und ehrlich gesagt eines der wertvollsten, die man 2026 lernen kann.

title: Founding People & Talent
description:
ZeitMind, the autonomous data engineer for the European mid-market

About Zeit AI

In the coming years, companies will replace their internal data teams with AI agents to run more efficiently. We will be the solution they'll use. ZeitMind connects to the systems companies already run (ERP, CRM, spreadsheets, internal databases), cleans messy data, runs analyses on its own and builds data applications. Every employee can then work with data in plain language, with no technical degree and no help from IT. Our customers use it to organise agricultural inventories, to schedule maintenance, crew and flights for jet operators, and to replace controllers' manual Excel reports.. Founded by Marvin and Leopold, both ex-Palantir. YC S24, backed by Oxford Seed Fund and Sequoia Scout. Customers in manufacturing, agriculture and aviation. Zero to €1M ARR in our first twelve months with six people. Small team, one room in Munich, regular team offsites.

What This Role Is

At our size, every hire shapes the company, and the team we build over the next year will decide how far ZeitMind goes. That's why this role matters so much to us.

As our first People hire, you own how people join and grow at Zeit AI, from a candidate's first touchpoint to their first months on the team. You make hiring fast, personal and professional. You keep us compliant across Germany and the UK, and you build the People foundations we'll rely on at 20, 50 and 100 people. You work directly with Marvin and Leopold, shape the function from day one, and help make Zeit AI a place great people want to join and stay.

Your Daily Business - no two days are alike

  • Recruiting in Ashby, end to end: job postings, sourcing support, screening, scheduling interviews, collecting feedback and following up with candidates. No candidate waits a week for an answer

  • Comfortable hiring for both technical and non-technical roles. You can run a process for a senior engineer as confidently as for a sales or ops hire, and you know what good looks like in each

  • Offers and contracts: you prepare offer slides that make candidates excited to say yes, and you draft and manage employment contracts through to signature

  • Candidate experience: every applicant, hired or not, leaves with a good impression of Zeit AI. You own interview guides, scorecards and the debrief rhythm with the hiring team

  • Onboarding: contracts, equipment, accounts and a first week that never feels improvised

  • Payroll and benefits: you run payroll with Project B, handle benefits and insurance, and keep finance up to date on headcount and people costs

  • HR systems and data: you own our People tools and keep employee records accurate and secure. You pull the numbers the founders need, such as time-to-hire, pipeline health and headcount plans

  • Compliance: you keep contracts, policies and processes in line with German and UK employment law and know when to bring in external counsel

  • Visa and relocation: you guide international hires through work permits, visas and moving to Munich if needed

  • People processes: you design how we run feedback, performance conversations and the operating rhythm, together with the founders

  • Team and culture: you lead offsites, team events, the office

  • Automation: you find the repetitive work in People Ops and automate it rather than just documenting it

Your Skillset - what you bring to the table

  • 2+ years in People Operations, Recruiting, HR Generalist or Talent roles, ideally at a fast-growing startup or scale-up

  • Hands-on recruiting experience with an ATS. Ashby is a plus, but Greenhouse, Lever, Personio or similar count too

  • Solid working knowledge of German and UK employment law, contracts and payroll processes.

  • Very organised with real attention to detail. Contracts, payroll and candidate follow-ups are exactly where details matter

  • Excellent communication. You handle a senior candidate, a new joiner and a founder in the same afternoon and adjust for each

  • Strong ownership and a bias to action. You build the process when there isn't one yet

  • AI-native: you already use AI tools to work faster, and you're excited to automate People processes

  • German and English fluently

  • Munich, or ready to relocate. This role does not work remotely

What We Offer

  • Full trust, maximum support. Full trust, maximum support. You build the People function from scratch

  • Munich is our hub. In-person by design, and we cover your relocation within Europe

  • Regular team offsites

  • Best tools, zero blockers. Daily lunch allowance, dinner covered in the office, Wellpass

  • €5k referral bonus if we hire someone you refer

title: Qualitätsmanager:in für App-, Website- und Filialen-Tests (m/w/d)
description:
Über uns

Probantica ist ein Anbieter für Qualitätstests aus Köln. Wir prüfen im Auftrag von Unternehmen, ob digitale Produkte und Abläufe vor Ort im Alltag funktionieren. Die Tests machen bei uns angestellte Qualitätsmanager:innen – Menschen mit Vertrag, fester Ansprechperson und klaren Vorgaben.

Worum es geht

Unternehmen müssen wissen, ob ihre Apps, Websites und Filialen im Alltag wirklich funktionieren. Als Kunde gehst du die angebotenen Abläufe durch: App öffnen, Konto anlegen, Formular ausfüllen, Bestellung abschließen, in eine Filiale gehen. Du testest den Prozess von Anfang bis Ende, dokumentierst jeden Schritt mit Uhrzeit und Screenshot und markierst die Stellen, an denen etwas hakt oder unklar bleibt.

Vor jedem Auftrag bekommst du eine Anleitung mit Schritten, Zeitrahmen und den Fragen, die am Ende beantwortet sein müssen. Kein Rätselraten, kein Vertrieb, keine Kaltakquise. Getestet wird auf deinem eigenen Gerät, in deiner Nähe.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Digitale Produkte testen: App, Website oder Online-Prozess einmal vollständig durchlaufen – von der Anmeldung bis zum Abschluss.
  • Abläufe vor Ort prüfen: in Filialen, Shops oder Servicestellen, mit Blick auf Wartezeit, Beratung und Abwicklung.
  • Auffälligkeiten festhalten: Screenshot machen, Uhrzeit notieren, in zwei bis fünf Sätzen beschreiben, was passiert ist.
  • Bericht einreichen: die vorgegebenen Fragen beantworten, Dauer je Schritt angeben, Ergebnis knapp zusammenfassen.
  • Nachfragen beantworten: wenn das Team zu einem Befund etwas wissen möchte, kurz und sachlich antworten.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist mindestens 18 Jahre alt.
  • Du hast ein Smartphone oder einen Laptop mit Internetzugang – Geräte für App- und Website-Tests stellst du selbst.
  • Du drückst dich in klaren, verständlichen Sätzen aus und arbeitest sorgfältig.
  • Du hältst Termine ein und meldest dich, wenn etwas nicht klappt.

Das brauchst du nicht

  • Kein Studium, keine Ausbildung in einem bestimmten Bereich, kein Führerschein.
  • Keine eigene Firma, keine Anmeldung beim Finanzamt.
  • Keine Kosten – weder für die Bewerbung noch für die Ausrüstung.

Vergütung pro Auftrag

Feste Pauschale je abgeschlossenem Auftrag, gestaffelt nach Umfang. Ausgezahlt wird monatlich, sobald der Bericht abgenommen ist – unabhängig davon, wie lange du gebraucht hast.

Richtwerte. Das konkrete Honorar steht in jedem Auftrag, bevor du ihn annimmst. Die Pauschale ist so bemessen, dass der gesetzliche Mindestlohn für die aufgewendete Zeit nicht unterschritten wird.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Faire Pauschale – bis zu 49 € pro Auftrag, monatlich ausgezahlt, ohne Provision und ohne Abzug.
  • Anstellung statt anonymer Crowd – Arbeitsvertrag und feste Ansprechperson statt Bewertungsplattform.
  • Minijob oder Teilzeit – Minijob bis zur Geringfügigkeitsgrenze (2026: 603 € monatlich), Teilzeit bis 20 Stunden pro Woche.
  • Flexible Einteilung – du sagst, wann du Zeit hast; keine festen Schichten.
  • Klare Vorgaben – jede Aufgabe mit Anleitung, Zeitrahmen und den Fragen für den Bericht.
  • Persönliche Begleitung – im Panel erreichst du deinen Supervisor direkt, ohne Ticket-System.
  • Kurzer Weg – Bewerbung in etwa zehn Minuten, Rückmeldung meist innerhalb von zwei Werktagen.

So läuft die Bewerbung

  1. Zehn Fragen beantworten (etwa 5 Minuten) – online, ohne Anmeldung, ohne Lebenslauf.
  2. Persönliche Daten eintragen – Name, Anschrift, Geburtsdatum, Kontaktdaten.
  3. Rückmeldung per E-Mail – bei einer Zusage kommen die Zugangsdaten für dein Panel mit.
  4. Arbeitsvertrag digital unterschreiben – Minijob oder Teilzeit.
  5. Onboarding im Panel – kurze Einführung, danach die ersten Aufträge.

Gut zu wissen

  • Keine Provision: bezahlt wird der abgeschlossene Auftrag, nicht die Anzahl gefundener Fehler.
  • Keine Vorkasse, keine Kaution, kein Verkauf an Freunde oder Familie.
  • Du bestimmst, wie viele Aufträge du übernimmst – es gibt keine Mindestanzahl.
  • Alle Geschlechter willkommen. Schwerbehinderte Bewerber:innen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.
