title: Founding Account Executive – Poland
description:
About Tacto

Tacto builds Industrial AI for procurement in manufacturing. Built for industrial complexity, designed to optimize every procurement decision.

Over 50% of a product’s cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world.

  • 400+ procurement organizations work with Tacto

  • ~110 people on the team in Munich

  • €50M+ raised, led by Sequoia and Index Ventures, with Cherry Ventures, UVC Partners and others

Our mission at Tacto

We make industry stronger.

Manufacturing is the backbone of the European economy, and supply chains are its biggest challenge. Yet procurement in many companies still runs on Excel and legacy systems. With AI, we are fundamentally changing how manufacturers buy: measurably lower material costs and far less manual work.

Your role

You open Poland for Tacto and win the first customers that everything else builds on.

Why this role exists

Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit and a proven playbook, and now we are taking it into the rest of Europe. Poland is one of our expansion markets. It has become one of Europe’s major manufacturing hubs, and the category is still wide open there. That’s where you come in: you take the market and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates and win the first customers and reference logos. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows in Poland from there.

Why your role matters

  • A real greenfield. You have the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market, from the ICP to the first reference logos.

  • You’re not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation.

  • You write the blueprint. What works in your first deals becomes the playbook for everyone who follows you in Poland.

  • You shape how Tacto goes international. Your insights go straight to Product, Marketing and Leadership.

What this role is and isn’t

  • Hands on: You send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won.

  • Not a managed territory: There is no machine behind you yet. You drive your own pipeline and build the motion as you go.

  • Not a remote role: You build Poland from our Munich office and travel into the market.

Your tasks

  • Open up Poland end to end: You sharpen the ICP for Polish manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the market’s growth.

  • Run the full sales cycle: Discovery, demo, potential analysis on real ERP data, ROI business case and closing.

  • Build the outbound playbook: Hand in hand with the expansion team, you develop messaging, sequences, segments and channels for your market.

  • Turn marketing into pipeline: You coordinate the marketing activities in your market so they generate pipeline.

  • Shape our international expansion: You feed structured insight back to Product, Marketing and Leadership.

Your profile

Experience and skills

  • Experience: Several years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex or technical products and multi-stakeholder buying processes

  • Track record: You’ve carried a number before and know what it takes to hit it without a machine behind you

  • Value selling: You grasp complex products and translate technical depth into business impact

  • Languages: Fluent, business-level English. Polish is a strong plus. We hire for mindset and ability, not origin or native language

  • Location: Based in Munich or ready to relocate

Core strengths

  • Entrepreneurial: You want to build and own a market result, and figure out the motion when the local one doesn’t exist yet

  • Hunter: You go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline

  • Builder: You turn what works into a system the next person can run

  • Thinks beyond the next deal: You lay Tacto’s foundation in your market, externally through brand, network and reference logos, internally through the playbook and the case for the market

You don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.

Our values

No fixed career path: everyone here grows their own way.

  • We stay real: Come as you are, wherever you come from.

  • Merit matters: Results count, not titles.

  • Bold ambitions: Excellence as the standard.

  • Real passion: Grit and ownership.

  • Transforming industrials: Close to our customers in manufacturing.

  • Fun built-in: We don’t take ourselves too seriously.

  • Caring is key: We help each other grow.

What we offer

What to expect

  • Building at the AI frontier: The newest models from day one, an AI Captain in every team and no limits on what you can try.

  • Growing with clear feedback: Regular feedback conversations mean you always know what it takes to reach the next step.

  • Munich’s tech ecosystem: Every week you meet leading founders and operators at our own and external events. All events: luma.com/tacto

Benefits

  • €1,500+ learning budget per year

  • 26 + 4 days of vacation

  • €300 childcare allowance per child

  • EGYM Wellpass

  • JobRad bike leasing and public transport tickets

  • Company pension plan and discounts

How you apply

Fast and transparent, with feedback after every step.

  1. Intro call with our Chief of Staff

  2. Deep dive with our Head of Revenue

  3. Get-to-know call with the AE you’d be working alongside

  4. Onsite interview incl. case study and team meetings

Equal opportunity and data protection

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We offer everyone the same opportunities regardless of ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity.

Please do not send us any personal data revealing your ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, and no data about your health or sexual orientation.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

title: Disponent:in Service Wärmepumpen (w/m/d) | Quereinsteiger:innen willkommen
description:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du koordinierst die täglichen Touren unserer Servicetechniker und stellst eine effiziente Auslastung sicher.

  • Du bist Ansprechpartner für Terminabstimmungen und sorgst dafür, dass alle Beteiligten die relevanten Informationen haben.

  • Du erkennst dringende Fälle (z. B. Heizungsausfall) und sorgst für eine schnelle Einplanung.

  • Du behältst jederzeit den Überblick zu laufenden Einsätzen, Kapazitäten und kurzfristigen Änderungen.

  • Du erkennst Optimierungspotenziale in der Disposition und hilfst dabei, unsere Serviceabläufe effizienter zu gestalten.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast eine organisierte und strukturierte Arbeitsweise zur effizienten Bearbeitung von Kundenanliegen.

  • Du hast Freude an Kundenkommunikation, insbesondere telefonisch.

  • Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung in Disposition, Einsatzplanung oder Servicekoordination.

  • Du zeichnest dich durch eine schnelle, aber dennoch sorgfältige und kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise aus.

  • Du verfügst über hervorragende Deutschkenntnisse.

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

  • Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

  • Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

  • Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen.

  • Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

  • Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.

  • Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.

  • Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As Vanta continues to grow, winning in the International markets will be critical. We’re just starting to establish our EMEA presence, and we need talented and customer focused Account Executives who are excited to help build and grow a large and untapped UK&I markets as we continue to distinguish Vanta as best-in-class to prospects in a burgeoning competitive landscape.

If this sounds like you, and you’re excited to be a part of our sales team in EMEA, we'd love to hear from you.

What you’ll do as an Account Executive at Vanta:

  • Own your pipeline from the ground up — identify, research, and prioritize high-potential accounts and verticals, building a consistent outbound motion to create new opportunities.

  • Run a world-class sales process — qualify deeply, forecast accurately, and progress deals using MEDDPICC or a similar structured methodology to drive predictable outcomes.

  • Convert interest into long-term value — educate prospects on the business impact of Vanta, deliver compelling demos, and tailor solution recommendations to each customer’s goals.

  • Communicate with executive presence — engage confidently with founders, CEOs, and technical leaders, translating complex compliance and security concepts into clear business value.

  • Continuously sharpen your craft — act on feedback, seek coaching, and contribute to improving team playbooks, messaging, and outbound best practices.

  • Be a self-starter who makes things happen — operate with urgency, ownership, and autonomy in a fast-moving environment where results matter.

  • Champion market expansion — explore partnership opportunities, represent Vanta at industry events, and help us deepen our presence in new and existing markets.

  • Cross-Functional — working alongside our SDR team, marketing team, legal and Solutions Engineers to find, run and win deals.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 3+ years closing experience

  • Have had a closing and quota-carrying role in the past, while consistently exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets

  • Be experienced in B2B SaaS, preferably in SMB and Mid-Market

  • Be highly curious, seeking to understand customers, their needs and how best Vanta can help them

  • Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software and build great relationships with highly technical prospects

  • Have stellar problem-solving skills, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up

  • Have entrepreneurial spirit, initiative and autonomy so you can make a huge contribution to the EMEA landing team

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-hybrid

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

title: Offre de stage de recherche Master 2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieur
description:
Dates : 6 mois à partir de février ou mars 2027

Contexte du projet :

L’allègement des structures automobiles reste un levier majeur pour réduire la consommation et les émissions des véhicules, tout en répondant à des exigences croissantes de rigidité et de tenue au crash. Les pièces de caisse en blanc sont en grande majorité réalisées à partir de tôles d’acier mises en forme, dont la conception repose encore largement sur l’expertise et sur des itérations successives entre calcul et dessin.

L’optimisation topologique permet de déterminer la meilleure répartition de matière dans un domaine de conception donné. Appliquée à un domaine volumique 3D, elle conduit cependant à des structures massives ou de type treillis, difficilement transposables en pièces embouties d’épaisseur quasi constante. Le défi scientifique consiste à formuler une méthode capable de faire émerger, à partir d’un domaine volumique, des géométries représentatives de tôles (structures à parois minces), en maîtrisant l’épaisseur et la fabricabilité, sous chargements statiques puis dynamiques.

Ce stage s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration de recherche entre le LTDS et ArcelorMittal Global R&D. Il a vocation à se poursuivre par une thèse CIFRE en cas de résultats concluants.

L’objectif du stage sera de développer et d’évaluer une première méthodologie d’optimisation topologique 3D aboutissant à une solution en tôle d’acier, en s’appuyant sur une structure automobile.

Les missions pourront comprendre :

•Un état de l’art des méthodes d’optimisation topologique conduisant à des structures minces de type coque (contrôle d’épaisseur par filtrage et projection, contraintes de longueur caractéristique, approches par composants explicites ou level-set).

•Le développement d’un algorithme d’optimisation 3D appliqué à une pièce automobile soumise à des chargements statiques.

•L’extension de la méthode à des solutions plus avancées proposées par ArcelorMittal.

Les missions pourront être adaptées en fonction du profil du candidat et de l’avancement du projet.


Profil recherché : étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou équivalent (stage ingénieur) dans le domaine de la mécanique numérique, du calcul des structures ou des mathématiques appliquées.

Compétences souhaitées : méthode des éléments finis, optimisation numérique, programmation scientifique (Python, MATLAB ou C++). Des connaissances en optimisation topologique ou en dynamique rapide (LS-DYNA, Radioss) seront appréciées.

Encadrement : Frédéric Gillot (LTDS, École Centrale de Lyon) ; Daoming Yu, Alexandre Blaise et Cristian Alvarez (ArcelorMittal Global R&D).

L’accueil au laboratoire est soumis à une autorisation préalable (procédure FSD, 2 à 3 mois de délai) : les candidatures (CV, lettre de motivation, relevés de notes) sont à adresser dès que possible.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

description:
Are you an IT architect who is equally comfortable designing a cloud architecture and getting hands-on to implement it? This might be for you.

We are looking for an IT System Architect on behalf of our client, a leading Swiss manufacturing company based in Canton Bern. The company is on a clear cloud transformation journey and needs someone to own it, drive it, and make it happen.

The role

You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and evolving the company's Azure cloud architecture end-to-end. This means taking ownership of Landing Zone design, hybrid networking, Entra ID and identity management, Azure Governance and policy frameworks, and security architecture. Beyond Azure, you will also take a broader IT architecture responsibility: defining standards, evaluating new technologies, coordinating external partners, and ensuring the company's IT landscape evolves in a structured and sustainable way. You will act as the trusted technical advisor to IT leadership and be expected to build internal know-how over time.

What we are looking for

  • You know Azure deeply, from having built things hands-on.

  • You are structured enough to think architecturally and pragmatic enough to roll up your sleeves when needed

  • You have experience coordinating external vendors and partners and keeping delivery on track

  • You communicate clearly with both engineers and management

  • You speak German fluently

Role info

  • Permanent position, 100% workload, Bern

  • Flexibility on remote work discussed at interview stage

Interested? Apply directly to learn more!

title: Product Engineer
description:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

As a Product Engineer at Namespace, you'll develop products that significantly enhance developer productivity. You'll build intuitive, performant user-facing applications and integrations that seamlessly fit into developers' existing workflows, directly impacting their ability to ship faster and more efficiently.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Own and ship end-to-end features that integrate seamlessly with popular developer tools

  • Develop user-facing applications that make powerful infrastructure intuitive and accessible to developers

  • Collaborate directly with users and partners to deeply understand their workflows, pain points, and product needs

  • Continuously iterate on product design and implementation to drive adoption, performance, and reliability

What we're looking for

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, with experience building production-grade software in languages like TypeScript/JavaScript (React), Go, Python, or similar

  • Proven track record shipping impactful product features, preferably for developer-focused or infrastructure products

  • Customer-centric mindset with the ability to translate complex technical solutions into intuitive user experiences

  • Enthusiasm for continuous learning and a collaborative approach to product development

You can expect:

  • Competitive salary and stock options

  • Flexible working hours

  • Market-leading parental leave

Life at Namespace Labs:

  • We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

  • We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

  • We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

Compensation: $160K – $225K • Offers Equity

title: Chief Operating Officer COO
description:
At Vio, we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites so that they can find the best place, at the best price, anywhere in the world.

Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence.

With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust.

Who we’re looking for

We are looking for an experienced Chief Operating Officer (COO) to join our Leadership Team and help us scale our booking operations, drive efficiency and deliver a best-in-class experience for our travelers.

Reporting to Oz , Our CEO, and joining Vio's Leadership Team, you'll be hired into the full organisation with a clear first focus: our booking (OTA) business. You'll lead Customer Support, OTA Finance, Payments and Legal, and work closely with our Product and Tech leads to optimise how we scale, simultaneously reducing our transactional and operational costs.

What you will do:

  • Scale our booking operations from ~4k bookings per day towards 20k–40k by 2028

  • Reduce our transactional and operational costs through continuous improvement, automation and smarter processes

  • Raise the quality of our user experience to match the best in the industry

  • Make sure our business operates smoothly across multiple jurisdictions

  • Support the scaling of our booking operations while limiting our risk exposure

  • Lead and develop your team: our Heads of Customer Support, OTA Finance and Payments and our Legal Counsel

Who you are:

  • A senior operations leader with experience scaling – not just operating at scale – ideally in a leadership position at a 500+ FTE organisation

  • Highly structured and analytically strong; data-fluent and comfortable making complex decisions in ambiguous situations

  • A proven track record of driving efficiency through continuous improvement, ideally in an online travel marketplace or accommodation distribution organisation

  • A pragmatic, flexible problem solver who fits operations to business needs rather than following frameworks or 'what we've done before'

  • Someone who simplifies for others, builds strong relationships and can hold critical lines

  • Experienced working in founder-led organisations and stepping into new, previously unowned areas

  • Travel industry experience is a big plus (especially flights / packages); B2C experience preferred, B2B welcome

  • Experience collaborating with enterprise partners is a real plus

Why join us now?

  • We’re one of the fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of millions of travelers each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of product features.

  • In 2026, we underwent a company-wide rebrand and launched our first StoryTelling marketing campaign in the UK. This was the next step in our commitment to help travelers book like insiders, and to establish Vio as a consumer-facing, creative brand.

  • The mobile applications (iOS and Android) we launched in 2023 have been a big success, reaching 5 million installs and earning strong customer reviews.

  • We’re a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives, with a commitment to the traveler above all else.

  • We reward our employees for the value they create by granting Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

What we offer:

  • Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture that promotes knowledge sharing, trust, and transparency.

  • A great compensation package, perks, and benefits – including significant stock appreciation rights.

  • Flexible time off, with as many holidays as you need, and a chance to work remotely.

  • You’ll be part of an international team in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam

  • We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden.

  • We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins, with company events in Amsterdam and abroad.

  • A budget for your home office

  • Access to free mental health support via OpenUp

We encourage people from all ethnic groups, genders, sexualities, ages, and abilities to apply. If this job description resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you.

Please note: This role is based in our Amsterdam office.

title: Performance Marketer (Remote - Netherlands)
description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

60 Million Users in 3 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 60 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

This is a hands-on role for someone who can execute fast, iterate with creative and funnel inputs, and scale what works. You’ll inherit high-performing campaigns and work directly with our CMO to double down on growth.

You’ll then also have the opportunity to test and scale new channels (TikTok, Meta, Snapchat, Native, ASA) depending on performance and market constraints.

Your Responsibilities

Campaign Ownership and Scaling

  • Take the lead on one or two paid acquisition channels (e.g., Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.), with potential to expand scope based on performance

  • Contribute to building scalable acquisition funnels, from execution to iteration, with aggressive growth targets in mind

  • Run high-velocity testing loops (creatives, audiences, placements) to improve CAC and LTV

Performance Analysis and Strategy

  • Monitor performance daily using tools like Voluum, GA4, and internal dashboards

  • Drive decision-making through deep analysis of CPA, ROAS, retention, and cohort behavior

  • Build and maintain internal reporting frameworks that guide strategic shifts and tactical moves

Creative & Funnel Optimization

  • Own the creative briefing process: define hooks, formats, and angles based on performance patterns

  • Collaborate closely with the content and product teams to launch and iterate on high-converting landing pages

  • Implement systems to reduce creative fatigue and increase speed of testing

Partnership Management & Media Strategy

  • Build strong relationships with traffic sources and negotiate premium placements and custom deals

  • Explore new acquisition opportunities (networks, formats, tools) and build internal evaluation criteria

  • Stay ahead of ecosystem changes (platform rules, algorithm shifts) and adapt strategy accordingly

Automation & Scaling Systems

  • Identify opportunities to streamline acquisition processes through automation and internal tools

  • Create SOPs, playbooks, and experiment pipelines for scaling campaigns efficiently

Challenges You’ll Tackle

  • Scale existing campaigns to 3x+ budget while maintaining CAC/ROAS goals

  • Contribute to growing the user base from 30M to 100M users in the next 12 months

  • Execute 0-to-1 testing in new channels

  • Improve conversion through landing page testing and funnel iteration

  • Own both creative input and analytical feedback loops

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

Must-Haves

  • 4–10+ years in performance marketing or user acquisition

  • Proven track record managing $300K to $1M+/month in paid media spend

  • Full ownership of campaign execution, results, and optimization

  • Experience with Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, ASA, or native platforms

  • Analytical fluency: GA4, Voluum, tracking setups, dashboards

  • Strong creative instincts: can write briefs, analyze hooks, and iterate fast

  • Experience optimizing landing pages and funnel conversion

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Past exposure to subscription models and CAC/LTV frameworks

  • Experience in sensitive or regulated verticals (e.g. dating, femtech, telehealth)

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy

⏱️ Obsessive about speed, performance and iteration

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - Comfortable advertising products based on uncensored models and content

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 60M users in 3 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 20 working days of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!


To learn how we collect and use your personal data during the recruitment process, please read our Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: Clinical Compliance Specialist
description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

Alimentiv is looking for an experienced Clinical Compliance Specialist to act as an advisor on ICH-GCP and other regulations and standards governing clinical research activities.

In this role, you will support and oversee quality and compliance across clinical studies, with a particular focus on imaging-related activities and the CRO vendors contracted to provide imaging services. You will partner with study teams to promote first-time quality, manage quality issues, assess compliance risks and maintain an inspection-ready environment.

Working closely with internal stakeholders, sponsors and external vendors, you will provide technical compliance guidance, support clinical study delivery and contribute to continuous improvement across the Quality & Compliance function.

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate the identification, investigation and resolution of quality issues, including root cause analysis and the development, implementation and monitoring of Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plans.

  • Partner with study teams to identify, assess and manage clinical research compliance risks, including protocol deviations and privacy incidents, ensuring timely resolution and escalation where required.

  • Apply risk-based quality management principles to identify potential compliance issues, assess their impact and support appropriate mitigation strategies.

  • Monitor quality metrics and key performance indicators, identifying trends and reporting findings to senior Quality & Compliance leadership.

  • Perform site audits and support study audits and inspections, including preparation, documentation review, coordination and follow-up on findings.

  • Act as a point of contact between study teams and auditors or inspectors during assigned audits and inspections, supporting preparation, interviews and follow-up activities.

  • Maintain study inspection readiness by ensuring study documentation is submitted for inclusion in the Trial Master File (TMF).

  • Oversee study-level training compliance, conducting reviews to ensure assigned training is completed on time.

  • Provide guidance on ICH-GCP and global quality, regulatory, ethics and privacy requirements, responding to inquiries from study teams, sponsors and customers.

  • Act as a trusted quality and compliance advisor to internal teams and external CRO vendors, providing practical guidance and technical support, particularly in relation to imaging-related activities.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, identifying opportunities to strengthen quality processes, monitor compliance performance and promote regulatory best practices.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (Honours) or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • 7–9 years of relevant experience in clinical research quality, clinical compliance or clinical risk management.

  • Demonstrated experience in clinical research and practical application of ICH-GCP principles. Clinical research and GCP experience are essential.

  • Experience in clinical quality management, compliance risk assessment and risk-based quality management.

  • Experience supporting or conducting clinical audits, inspections and inspection readiness activities.

  • Experience in clinical quality issue investigations, protocol deviations, root cause analysis (RCA) and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) management.

  • Strong knowledge of ICH-GCP principles and global regulations governing clinical research activities.

  • Knowledge of ISO 20916 and ISO 14155 standards.

  • Experience in a Project Quality and Risk Lead (PQRL) or similar clinical quality and risk management role within a CRO environment would be advantageous.

  • Experience in medical imaging, imaging-related clinical research or imaging vendor oversight would be highly advantageous.

  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify risks, investigate root causes and assess the effectiveness of corrective actions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, facilitate discussions and provide constructive feedback.

  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and communicate complex regulatory and compliance requirements effectively.

  • Knowledge of Quality by Design (QbD) principles.

  • Fluency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

Industry Experience

  • Clinical research and clinical trial experience is essential.

  • Experience within a Contract Research Organisation (CRO) environment is highly desirable.

  • Experience working with clinical study teams, sponsors and external clinical research vendors is beneficial.

  • Medical imaging or clinical imaging vendor experience is advantageous.

What We Offer

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.

Compensation

Additional Information

Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

title: Commercial Account Executive - Berlin
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for an Account Executive, Commercial to join our team in Berlin reporting to the Sales Director in the Sales and Go-to-Market department. You will drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future by managing a territory focused on net new logo and up-sell opportunities for accounts with 750 to 5,000 users. Your focus is on building high-impact business cases that demonstrate clear value and differentiation across all levels of prospect organizations.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

title: Product Support Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE PRODUCT SUPPORT SPECIALIST ROLE:

WIN is looking for Product Support Specialists to provide exceptional support to users of our cloud-based applications and digital products. You will develop a deep understanding of our products, business processes, and user needs to help users navigate features, troubleshoot issues, configure applications, and get the most value from our technology.

We are looking for people who are curious, resourceful, and highly user-focused. You should enjoy solving problems, learning how products work, and explaining solutions in a simple and empathetic way. You will also be expected to embrace AI and modern productivity tools to research issues faster, improve documentation, identify patterns, and make support more efficient and scalable.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop deep product and business knowledge to become a Subject Matter Expert across WIN's cloud-based applications, websites, and internal platforms.

  • Support users by understanding their needs, answering product questions, explaining features, and helping them effectively navigate and utilize applications.

  • Troubleshoot product and application issues, identify root causes, and provide timely and practical resolutions.

  • Configure cloud-based applications and product settings based on user and business requirements.

  • Manage and prioritize requests through the ticketing system, ensuring timely follow-up, accurate resolution, and a positive user experience.

  • Use AI and modern productivity tools to accelerate issue research, summarize information, troubleshoot efficiently, and improve the quality and speed of support.

  • Identify recurring questions, issues, and user pain points and use these insights to recommend improvements to products, processes, and support resources.

  • Create and maintain clear product guides, FAQs, troubleshooting instructions, knowledge-base articles, and issue-resolution documentation.

  • Leverage AI to help organize and improve knowledge content, while ensuring information shared with users is accurate, clear, and relevant.

  • Support new product features, releases, and enhancements by understanding changes, testing user scenarios, updating documentation, and helping users adopt new functionality.

  • Communicate resolutions and product guidance clearly to users and stakeholders, translating technical or product concepts into simple language.

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Operations, and other cross-functional teams to escalate issues, share user feedback, and improve the overall product experience.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2–5 years of experience in Product Support, Application Support, SaaS Support, Technical Support, or a similar role supporting cloud-based business applications.

  • Strong ability to understand software products, business workflows, and application functionality and translate that knowledge into effective user support.

  • Hands-on experience with ticketing, help desk, CRM, or knowledge management platforms.

  • Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, or similar tools to research, summarize, document, and manage work more efficiently.

  • Strong curiosity and willingness to experiment with new AI tools, technologies, and more efficient ways of working.

  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate issues systematically.

  • Strong user empathy and the ability to understand problems from the user's perspective rather than focusing only on the technical issue.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex concepts in simple, easy-to-understand terms.

  • Ability to create clear and structured product documentation, FAQs, and knowledge-base content.

  • Strong attention to detail, responsiveness, and ability to manage multiple user requests and priorities.

  • Comfortable working in rotational shifts to support users across different time zones.

  • Strong work ethic, high integrity, ownership mindset, and positive attitude.

WHAT WE OFFER:

  • Highly inclusive and collaborative culture
  • Opportunity to work closely with India-based and US-based teams
  • Strong focus on learning, ownership, and growth
  • 100% remote working flexibility

ABOUT WIN AND OUR CULTURE:

WIN is the #1 ranked inspection services company in the United States. Backed by 35 years of excellence, we are on a mission to build a global brand through cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven innovation, and operational excellence. WIN has the stability of an established leader as well as the energy of a fast-growing organization. We offer like-minded professionals a unique opportunity for meaningful personal and professional growth.

title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Content Reviewer - United States
description:
Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMastâ¢ system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing networkâcombining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. With 600+ sensors deployed across 25+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like. We are a mission-driven, high-velocity team building dual-use technology for defense agencies, coast guards, and commercial maritime operators.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Quality Engineer to strengthen our quality systems and support rising production volumes across Quartermasterâs SmartMastâ¢ systems and related marine products. This role will help us reduce defects and field returns, lead structured root-cause investigations, and keep our hardware manufacturing and deployment operations audit-ready as we scale globally. The right candidate has strong hands-on experience building practical quality management processes for electromechanical hardware in demanding environments, and can partner effectively across engineering, supply chain, and contract manufacturers to catch issues early and drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and scale our Quality Management System (QMS), standard operating procedures, and inspection protocols to ensure continuous audit readiness (e.g., ISO 9001 / AS9100 standards).

  • Partner with mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing engineers during New Product Introduction (NPI) to establish Design for Quality (DFQ), PFMEA, control plans, and incoming/in-process/final acceptance test criteria.

  • Collaborate with contract manufacturers and component suppliers on First Article Inspections (FAI), supplier audits, non-conforming material review (MRB), and corrective action follow-through.

Qualifications (Preferred):

  • Strong command of root-cause analysis and quality tools (CAPA, 8D, FMEA, Control Plans, SPC, and First Article Inspection).

  • Experience working directly with contract manufacturers and suppliers to qualify parts, resolve production defects, and enforce quality standards.

  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 or AS9100 quality frameworks and maintaining audit-ready documentation.

  • Ability to work independently and communicate clearly across remote engineering teams, field operations, and manufacturing partners.

  • ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Six Sigma certification is a plus.

Work Environment:

  • Flexible working hours, with occasional intensive sprints aligned to production milestones and audits.

  • Occasional travel to contract manufacturers, suppliers, or field deployment sites.

  • Opportunity to work on innovative projects with a global impact.

title: Technical Architect
description:
Role Description

As a Technical Architect at Dropbox, you will help enterprise customers translate business goals and complex technical requirements into practical solution architectures. You will work with customers and internal teams to design how Dropbox fits into their existing systems, validate critical assumptions, and guide implementation and adoption.

You will lead architecture discussions spanning workflows, integrations, identity and access, data movement, and operational readiness. You will explain design choices and tradeoffs, identify technical risks early, and produce clear guidance that implementation teams can act on. You will also turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable patterns and actionable feedback for Product and Engineering.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery with customer business and IT stakeholders to establish requirements, constraints, dependencies, and measurable success criteria.
  • Design and document solution architectures, including system boundaries, integration and data flows, identity and permission models, and operational requirements.
  • Evaluate design options and explain tradeoffs in reliability, security, performance, implementation effort, and ongoing cost.
  • Validate high-risk assumptions through focused prototypes, integration tests, or technical evaluations with explicit acceptance criteria.
  • Guide implementation and migration planning, defining sequencing, owners, testing, cutover, rollback, and handoff to delivery and support teams.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Support, Sales, Product, and Engineering to resolve technical blockers and connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes.
  • Create reusable reference architectures, implementation guidance, and enablement materials; mentor colleagues and communicate recurring product gaps.

Requirements

  • Customer-facing technical experience: At least 3 years in technical architecture, solutions architecture, implementation consulting, or a similar role, leading discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and technical validation for enterprise SaaS customers.
  • AI experience: Experience using AI tools for technical analysis, solution design, or prototyping, including validating outputs, protecting customer data, and assessing limitations.
  • Integration expertise: Experience designing and troubleshooting API integrations, authentication, data flows, and failure handling.
  • Identity and access: Understanding of IAM and Zero Trust principles, including SSO, SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, MFA, RBAC, conditional access, and how permissions and sharing affect data exposure.
  • Implementation and migration: Experience planning implementations or migrations and coordinating dependencies, technical risks, and handoffs across teams.
  • Technical communication: Ability to write clear technical documentation, lead workshops, and explain design decisions to technical and business audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Expertise in at least one of the following areas:

  • CASB/SSE/DLP platforms: Experience with enterprise security platforms such as Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Forcepoint, Broadcom/Symantec DLP, or similar technologies.

  • Identity and access management: Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or Ping Identity, including managing identities, permissions, and groups and applying least-privilege access principles to SaaS applications.

  • Security ecosystems and integrations: Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, APIs, OAuth, event and audit logs, or security integrations, including an understanding of how SaaS and data security solutions fit into a customerâs broader security architecture.

  • Security and compliance frameworks: Experience applying frameworks or regulatory requirements such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS to address enterprise customer needs.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read thisÂ blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

title: Werkstudent LinkedIn Content & Copywriting (B2B) | remote möglich, 10–20 Std./Woche
description:
Wer wir sind

F& | FOCUS & FLOW ist ein Beratungs-Hub für Transformation und Prozessverbesserung. Wir arbeiten vor allem mit Unternehmen aus dem produzierenden Mittelstand: mit Geschäftsführer:innen und Führungsteams, die ihre Organisation wirksamer aufstellen wollen, ohne sich im Methoden-Dschungel zu verlieren. Daraus entwickeln wir Beratungsprodukte, Trainings und Workshops, vor Ort und virtuell. Unser Anspruch dabei ist, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Gemeinwohl zusammenzudenken.

Unser Team ist klein, die Wege sind kurz. Wer bei uns mitarbeitet, sieht schnell, was die eigene Arbeit bewirkt.

Aufgaben

WAS DICH BEI UNS ERWARTET:

Im Mittelpunkt steht die LinkedIn-Präsenz unseres Geschäftsführers. Er ist das Gesicht von FOCUS & FLOW und für viele unserer Kund:innen der erste Berührungspunkt mit uns. Deine Aufgabe ist es, diese Präsenz mit ihm gemeinsam aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du schreibst LinkedIn-Beiträge in seiner Stimme. Dafür lernst du, wie er denkt, argumentiert und formuliert, und triffst seine Tonalität so, dass seine Beiträge nach ihm klingen und nicht nach Marketing.

  • Du entwickelst mit ihm Themen und Formate, planst die Veröffentlichungen und hältst den Redaktionsplan am Laufen.

  • Du baust sein Netzwerk strategisch aus: Du identifizierst relevante Entscheider:innen aus dem Mittelstand, bereitest Vernetzungen vor und behältst im Blick, wer auf seine Inhalte reagiert.

  • Interessante Kontakte übergibst du strukturiert an unser Pre-Sales-Team und stimmst dich eng mit den Kolleg:innen ab. So wird aus Reichweite echtes Geschäft.

  • Du wertest aus, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab.

  • Daneben unterstützt du bei der Unternehmensseite, erstellst Grafiken, Karussells und kurze Videos und arbeitest an Landingpages und Website-Inhalten mit, inklusive Optimierung für Suchmaschinen (SEO) und KI-gestützte Suchsysteme wie ChatGPT, Perplexity oder Google AI Overviews (GEO).

Qualifikation

WAS DU MITBRINGST:

  • Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben, ab dem 3. Semester oder im Master, idealerweise in Marketing, Kommunikations- oder Medienwissenschaften, Journalismus, Germanistik, Wirtschaftspsychologie oder einem vergleichbaren Fach.

  • Du schreibst richtig gut. Du kannst dich in andere Menschen hineindenken und ihre Sprache treffen, statt überall deinen eigenen Stil durchzuziehen.

  • Du hast erste Erfahrung mit Copywriting oder Content-Erstellung, ob im Praktikum, im Studium, für einen eigenen Kanal oder im Ehrenamt.

  • LinkedIn kennst du nicht nur als Nutzer:in, sondern hast ein Gespür dafür, was dort im B2B-Bereich funktioniert.

  • Du interessierst dich für Unternehmen und Wirtschaftsthemen und hast keine Scheu, mit Geschäftsführer:innen auf Augenhöhe zu kommunizieren.

  • Du gehst vertraulich mit Informationen um und arbeitest selbstständig und verlässlich.

  • Tools wie Canva, CapCut oder Kenntnisse in SEO/GEO sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

Benefits

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN:

  • 10 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche, flexibel um Vorlesungen und Prüfungsphasen herum

  • Vollständig remote möglich; unser Büro in Türkheim steht dir offen, wenn du in der Nähe bist

  • Vergütung ab 15 € pro Stunde, je nach Erfahrung und Können

  • MacBook als Arbeitsgerät

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und eine feste Ansprechpartnerin

  • Einblick, wie Vertrieb und Positionierung im B2B-Beratungsgeschäft wirklich funktionieren

  • Teamevents

Eckdaten:

Start: ab sofort

Arbeitsort: remote

Umfang: 10–20 Std./Woche

Befristung: für die Dauer des Studiums

Vergütung: ab 15 € pro Stunde

KLINGT NACH DIR?

Schick uns ein paar Zeilen dazu, was dich an der Stelle reizt, deinen Lebenslauf und zwei, drei Textproben (Posts, Artikel, Blogbeiträge oder Ähnliches). Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

F& | FOCUS & FLOW
