title: Associate Security Engineer
description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

Security at KAYAK is a team effort — we protect the people, systems, and data that power travel for millions of users worldwide, and we do it by working closely with engineering, operations, and product teams. As an Associate Security Engineer, you will help to drive our vulnerability management program while contributing across multiple security domains in a collaborative, globally distributed environment. You can find more information about our security program at https://www.kayak.com/security.

This role is required to work from our Berlin, Germany office 3 days per week.

In this role, you will:

  • Support and continuously improve the vulnerability management program — defining processes for identifying, prioritizing, tracking, and driving remediation of security findings across infrastructure and applications. This includes working closely with engineering, operations, and IT teams to ensure findings are understood, assigned, and resolved in a timely manner, and reporting on program health and trends to security leadership.

  • Participate in incident response activities, including triage, investigation, containment, and post-incident documentation.

  • Support application security initiatives, including automated code scanning, dependency analysis, and working with engineering teams to address security findings early in the development process.

  • Help configure, monitor, and improve security tooling across areas such as endpoint protection, email security, identity and access management, and cloud security posture.

  • Contribute to security automation and orchestration workflows that reduce manual effort and improve response times.

  • Collaborate with engineering, operations, and compliance teams to embed security thinking into development workflows and infrastructure changes.

  • Document processes, runbooks, and findings to support team knowledge sharing and continuity.

  • Participate in access reviews and support identity and access management processes in line with established policies.

  • Stay current with the evolving threat landscape and contribute ideas for improving the team's detection and response capabilities.

Please apply if you have:

  • A solid understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals — including networking, operating systems (Linux, macOS, or Windows), and cloud environments — gained through any combination of formal education, self-study, bootcamps, or professional experience.

  • Hands-on experience in at least one security domain, such as vulnerability management, incident response, application security, endpoint security, or identity and access management.

  • Experience working with security tooling (e.g., vulnerability scanners, endpoint detection and response platforms, SIEM systems, or similar); familiarity with specific tools is a plus, but willingness to learn our stack matters more than exact tool experience.

  • Familiarity with AI tools and how they can be applied in a security context — whether for automating workflows, triaging alerts, or improving detection and response. Experience working with AI models or building AI-assisted workflows is a plus.

  • The ability to communicate clearly in writing and in conversation — our team is globally distributed and works primarily in English (professional working proficiency is sufficient; native fluency is not required).

  • A collaborative approach to problem-solving — you ask questions, share what you learn, and support your teammates.

  • Comfort working with some degree of autonomy on assigned tasks and projects, while knowing when to ask for input.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Familiarity with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework or similar security frameworks.

  • Experience with cloud environments (AWS or GCP) or container security.

  • Exposure to security automation or scripting (e.g., Python, workflow automation tools).

  • Experience working in a regulated environment (e.g., SOC 2, PCI).

Benefits and Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

  • Focus on mental health and well-being:

    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace

    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

  • No meeting Fridays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday

  • Paid volunteer time

  • Focus on your career growth:

    • Development Dollars

    • Leadership development

    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

  • Travel Discounts

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • 6 weeks paid vacation

  • Free lunch 2 days per week

  • Pension plan contributions

  • Public transportation subsidies

  • Bike leasing program

  • Monthly social events, Thursday happy hours, sports teams

  • An awesome office in Friedrichshain, Berlin

 

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We’ve got you.

#LI-AS1

As the first Solutions Engineer for the German market, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the region’s success, but you will have the support from the whole EMEA team. 
 
This role will be foundational to 360learning business expansion. Reinforcing a new function in Germany, as a Solutions Engineer, you will become an internal expert in our technology, developing a deep understanding of how 360learning is being used by current customers and how it can drive value for future ones. You will bridge the gap between the strategic direction of our product development and the needs of our market.

Within 1 month, you will:
  • Become an expert of 360Learning ways of working through our onboarding process on Convexity
  • Meet the global team through virtual coffee meets and happy hours
  • Master our value proposition like no one else thanks to shadow meetings with AEs and intensive training with your coach

  • Have defined your first OKR

  • Collaborate with sales teams to understand customer requirements and provide sales support
  • Be a responsive and creative member of a cross-functional teams (sales, marketing, customer success) by providing valued feedback internally to our teams
  • Plan and configure products to meet presentation needs
  • Be a creative, upbeat, and positive player collaborating with AEs to build engaging strategies to move deals forward in our sales funnel (POC/pilot construction)

    • Within 6 months, you will:
  • Become a trusted advisor to all levels within the prospective customer organization from CEOs, to Developers, to Learning and Development Directors
  • Be identified as a prime expert by our Account Executives to support them in any prospective context
  • Share your expertise with other team members and 360Learners

    • Within 12 months, you will:
  • Contribute in making the Solutions Engineering department grow by identifying best practices, designing new processes and creating new contribution for the team
  • Work alongside sales team members at every step of the sales process
  • Help shape the Solutions Engineering team by recruiting your colleagues

    • The Skills Set:
  • 5+ years’ experience working either as a Pre-Sales, Solutions Engineer, Engagement Management, or LMS implementation consultant, ideally in the SaaS industry
  • A consultative selling background
  • Knowledge of enterprise technologies and systems, including SSO, CRM, ERP or HRIS
  • Proven ability to demonstrate technical expertise while interacting with high level stakeholders such as CTO, CISO
  • Ability to lead technical workshops  (ex : SaaS integrations, Middleware, ETL, API, Web Services, …)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Fluent German and business fluent English proficiency; other languages are a plus
  • Enthusiasm for our culture explained here: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L

    • What We Offer:
  • Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈
  • Benefits: Work From Home perks, 1 month parental leave for the second parent
  • Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in Germany 🏠. Working remotely from outside Germany is also possible, subject to some conditions (tenure, performance, destination, length, etc.) and the approval of our Remote Committee 🌍
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate-social-responsibility-charter 🌎🌏🌍
  • Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision what's it like to join 360Learning through our onboarding journey: https://360learning.com/blog/360learner-journey/ & Convexity Culture: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆

    • Interview process:
  • Interview with our Recruiter
  • Discovery Meeting with our Head of Solutions Engineering
  • Role-play with our Head of Sales Engineering and our Solutions Engineer
  • Clarification Meeting with our Sales Enterprise Director
  • Culture Fit Meeting with our CRO

    360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth.     360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment. We want to learn from and with you!

title: Simulation Engineer - Drone Physical Models Integration
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As our GNC, ML, Embedded Software, and Validation teams scale, they rely increasingly on simulation to develop and test our autonomous defense systems. The value of that simulation depends directly on how faithfully it reproduces the real behavior of our drones.

Joining the Tooling team, you will be responsible for bringing the physical models of our drones into the simulator—including aerodynamics, propulsion, electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems. Designed by expert domain teams, these models require your expertise to translate user needs, integrate models into the simulator software stack, and validate expected behavior. Because not every use case requires the same level of realism, you will help establish the appropriate fidelity targets across applications.

This role offers high ownership and the opportunity to work at the intersection of physics, software engineering, and AI robotics with direct mission impact.

Responsibilities

  • Coordination with Domain Experts: Work with the teams in charge of aerodynamics, propulsion, electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems to understand their models, their assumptions, and their inputs and outputs, and to agree on how they are delivered to the simulator.

  • Model Integration: Integrate these models into the simulator software stack in a clean, performant, and maintainable way, with clear interfaces and configurable parameters.

  • Validation: Define and run tests that check the integrated models against the reference data given by the expert teams (flight logs, bench tests, manufacturer data), and report discrepancies back to the model owners.

  • User Needs & Fidelity Targets: Work with the simulator users (GNC, Embedded, Validation) to understand their use cases, and translate them into a realism target for each model. Pick the right balance between fidelity, performance, and integration effort, and prioritise the model integration work to match.

  • Documentation & Standards: Document the integrated models, their parameters, validity domains, and validation results, and help standardise the model integration and validation process.

Candidate requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in software engineering, simulation, or a related engineering field.

  • Physics Understanding: Good understanding of flight dynamics and enough physics background to discuss models with experts in aerodynamics, propulsion, electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems, and to turn their models into working code.

  • Integration & Validation: Experience integrating third-party models or components into a larger software system, and validating them against experimental data with a rigorous approach.

  • Technical Proficiency: Comfortable with C++ and Python, with a good knowledge of Linux environments.

  • Educational Background: MSc or BSc in Aerospace Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, Applied Physics, or a similar technical field; equivalent professional experience is equally valued.

Plus (nice to have)

  • Experience with drones or robotic systems, ideally with open-source autopilots like PX4 or ArduPilot.

  • Hands-on experience with flight testing, test benches, or log analysis.

  • French language skills.

Mindset

  • Rigor: Empirical and disciplined about validation, grounded in real test data, and skeptical of a result that only exists in simulation.

  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication, comfortable working with several specialized teams, asking the right questions, and sharing validation results with them.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Overview

We are hiring Quality Control (QC) evaluators for a project that spans both Search and Linguistic tasks. You will perform quality checks on initial ratings produced by evaluators—validating user intent assessment, query annotation, text classification, and multimedia (video, image, audio) reviews for relevance, accuracy, and guideline adherence. The ideal candidate combines strong language skills with sharp analytical judgment, excellent documentation and feedback skills, and familiarity with short-form video culture

What you will do

  • Audit samples of initial ratings for relevance, intent alignment, taxonomy compliance, and linguistic quality.
  • Re-rate items (double-scoring) to verify labels; resolve discrepancies and document decisions.
  • Perform linguistic quality checks (grammar, tone, clarity, local relevance) and media comprehension reviews.
  • Classify and track errors using an agreed error taxonomy; surface trends and edge cases.
  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to evaluators; contribute to guideline clarifications and updates.
  • Participate in and lead calibration sessions to drive inter-rater agreement.
  • Track and report QC metrics (e.g., agreement rates, accuracy, error trends) and meet QC SLAs.
  • Triage escalations, handle ambiguous cases, and ensure data integrity and compliance.
  • Use internal tools to complete, track, and submit QC tasks accurately.

Project Details

Engagement Type: Freelance

Rate: USD 27/hour

Estimated Hours: 15-30 hours/week

Requirement

  • English at C1 level or higher.
  • Native or near-native speaker level in French language with strong reading, writing, and listening comprehension.
  • Excellent grammar, writing, and proofreading skills.
  • Strong video and image comprehension; good hearing ability for audio tasks.
  • Solid understanding of search engines, user intent, and web content.
  • High attention to detail, consistency, and guideline adherence.
  • Ability to deliver clear written feedback and rationale.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in QC/QA for text classification, query annotation, data labeling, or search quality evaluation.
  • Familiarity with short dramas and local short-drama culture/platforms.
  • Experience with calibrations, sampling, scorecards, and root-cause analysis.
  • Comfortable working with productivity and quality targets; proficient with spreadsheets/QA tools.

description:
Role type: Contractor

Commitment: Part-time, project-based

About the role

micro1 is looking for experienced Medical Oncologists to support a customer project focused on improving AI-generated clinical documentation.

In this role, you'll use your clinical expertise to evaluate AI-generated transcripts and medical notes from outpatient oncology encounters. Your feedback will help improve the accuracy, completeness, and clinical relevance of AI-assisted documentation.

What you'll do

  1. Review AI-generated transcripts of outpatient oncology visits for clinical accuracy, completeness, and clarity.
  2. Evaluate clinical documentation, including History of Present Illness (HPI), interval histories, and Assessment and Plans (A&Ps).
  3. Identify inaccuracies or missing details related to cancer diagnoses, staging, treatment plans, and laboratory or imaging findings.
  4. Assess documentation of systemic cancer therapies, including chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapies, and supportive care.
  5. Review how clinical notes capture treatment responses, adverse effects, disease progression, and follow-up care.
  6. Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve AI-generated clinical notes and EHR documentation.

Required qualifications

  1. MD, DO, or equivalent medical degree, with board certification or eligibility in Medical Oncology.
  2. At least 2 years of recent outpatient medical oncology experience following fellowship.
  3. Strong clinical experience diagnosing and managing solid tumors, including treatment planning and longitudinal patient care.
  4. Proven ability to independently document HPIs, interval histories, and Assessment and Plans.
  5. Solid understanding of systemic cancer therapies, treatment-related toxicities, supportive care, and interpretation of laboratory and imaging results.
  6. Strong written communication skills and attention to clinical detail.
  7. Based in the United States.

Preferred qualifications

  1. Experience managing a broad range of solid tumors and complex oncology cases.
  2. Familiarity with AI scribe technology, EHR documentation templates, medical chart review, or clinical annotation projects.

Candidates will complete an AI interview to assess their relevant clinical expertise and experience.

Recruiting Assistant – Remote (Latin America)

Independent Contractor | Part-Time | USD $700–$900 Monthly

Grow Your Career in Talent Acquisition With Us!

Do you enjoy connecting with people, discovering talent, and helping others find meaningful career opportunities?

At Mendoza Companies, we're looking for a proactive, organized, and people-oriented Recruiting Assistant to support our Talent Acquisition efforts and help us create a positive experience for every candidate.

This opportunity is ideal for someone with some recruiting experience who enjoys learning, takes initiative, and is excited to develop professionally while supporting recruitment for U.S.-based operations.

You'll play an important role in keeping our hiring processes organized and moving forward, from reviewing applications and coordinating interviews to connecting with candidates and supporting their journey through the recruitment process.

We're not looking for someone who knows everything. We're looking for someone who is curious, dependable, detail-oriented, and genuinely motivated to grow with us.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Connecting with talent: Review applications, resumes, and screening responses to identify candidates who align with our job requirements.
  • Supporting the interview process: Coordinate AI-assisted interviews, communicate with candidates, monitor completion, and help them navigate the process.
  • Getting involved in interviews: Conduct structured first-round interviews for selected positions as you develop familiarity with our recruiting processes and expectations.
  • Exploring candidate assessments: Assist with researching, coordinating, and tracking approved job-related skills assessments and non-clinical psychometric evaluations.
  • Creating a great candidate experience: Maintain friendly, professional, and timely communication with candidates, including interview scheduling, updates, reminders, and follow-ups.
  • Keeping things organized: Maintain accurate candidate information, interview notes, and recruiting stages in BambooHR and other recruiting tools.
  • Helping us reach more candidates: Support approved job advertisements, sourcing activities, and recruiting outreach through LinkedIn, Facebook, job boards, and other platforms.
  • Supporting the hiring process: Assist with approved reference checks, recruiting updates, and basic coordination for new team members.

As you become more familiar with our company and processes, there may also be opportunities to support additional Human Resources administrative activities based on business needs and mutually agreed responsibilities.

What We're Looking For

  • Around 1 year of experience in recruitment, candidate screening, or Talent Acquisition support preferred.
  • Strong conversational and written English and Spanish, with the confidence to communicate professionally with U.S.-based candidates and conduct interviews in English.
  • Experience reviewing resumes, coordinating interviews, or communicating with candidates throughout a hiring process.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize multiple activities.
  • A proactive, dependable attitude and the ability to follow through on commitments.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, active listening, and a genuine interest in helping people.
  • Comfortable using Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Word, and basic Excel.
  • Willingness to learn new technology, including applicant tracking systems and AI-assisted recruiting tools.
  • Studies or a degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field are preferred.

Nice to Have (Not Required):

  • Experience using BambooHR or similar applicant tracking systems.
  • Familiarity with skills assessments or psychometric testing platforms.
  • Previous exposure to recruiting for U.S.-based companies.
  • Experience with Canva, LinkedIn, or social media recruiting.

What Makes This Opportunity Special?

We believe that great recruiting is about more than filling positions. It's about connecting the right people with meaningful opportunities while creating a respectful and positive experience throughout the process.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Gain practical exposure to recruiting for U.S.-based operations, including California and Nevada.
  • Develop your interviewing, candidate assessment, and recruitment coordination skills.
  • Explore how technology and AI can support modern Talent Acquisition.
  • Collaborate with people across different teams and professional backgrounds.
  • Contribute ideas, learn from feedback, and help us continuously improve our processes.

We value people who take ownership of their responsibilities, communicate openly, and are willing to learn and grow.

Location: Remote – Latin America

Engagement Type: Part-Time Independent Contractor

Compensation: USD $700–$900 monthly service fee, depending on qualifications and relevant experience.

Initial Scope: Part-time services anticipated to be comparable to approximately 25 hours per week, with flexibility in organizing activities and coordination needs related to U.S. business operations.

Future Opportunities: The scope of services may expand to include additional recruiting or HR administrative responsibilities, depending on business needs, demonstrated capabilities, and mutual agreement.

Reliable internet access, suitable equipment, and a private environment for candidate communications are required.

A Little About Us

Mendoza Companies brings together businesses built around a shared mission, strong values, and a commitment to people.

Our companies include High-Light Electric, Inc. (HLE), a California-based electrical infrastructure contractor established in 1996, supporting public works and infrastructure projects that serve communities across California.

Guided by The Mendoza Way, we believe in professionalism, respect, service, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Our long-term Mission 2040 reflects our commitment to building businesses that create opportunities and positively impact families and communities.

We're proud of where we've come from, excited about where we're going, and always looking for people who want to contribute to something meaningful.

If you need an accommodation or an alternative way to participate in an assessment or interview, please let our recruiting team know.

Interested in growing your Talent Acquisition experience while making a positive impact? We'd love to learn more about you!

title: Consultancy - support BirdLife Europe and Central Asia's Policy team
description:
Application deadline:Monday 30 November 2026 - 12:00 CET

Budget:Maximum of 10,000 EUR (excluding VAT) for the first year of the consultancy

Location: Remote

Duration: One year

Stichting BirdLife Europe is looking for a consultant to provide on demand support to the ECA policy team in coordinating work at Brussels level and advocacy at national level around European and global nature policies, and their implementation, with specific expertise in the field of bird conservation. In particular, the consultant will support interested BirdLife Partners at national level on specific issues related to BirdLife priorities.

EXPECTED DELIVERABLES:

  • Provide expertise to support BirdLife Europe's work on global and EU nature related policies. The consultant will provide specific support to BirdLife Partners at national level, where relevant and linked to BirdLife priorities.

  • Support the Policy Manager and Policy team in the advocacy and implementation of nature conservation policies in the EU and Member States; support the development of BirdLife positions and technical briefings related to nature policy at EU level for the EU institutions.

  • Support the delivery of projects managed by the policy team in relation to nature policy.

  • Support BirdLife Europe in producing relevant information on positions, activities and strategies.

  • Support BirdLife Europe in its participation in EU technical committees, working groups and other forums related to nature conservation.

QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED:

  • Relevant academic degree, with degrees in Environmental Sciences and Biology particularly relevant (additional work experience may be accepted in lieu of this).

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience with nature and conservation policy advocacy and implementation, at EU and at regional European and Central Asian level.

  • Relevant experience linked to species conservation.

  • Prior experience with the BirdLife partnership is an advantage.

  • Experience on the implementation of nature conservation policies at national level an advantage.

  • Have a sound grasp of the operation of EU institutions, and relevant Environmental International Agreements.

  • Ability to understand and present, in written and oral form, policy documents.

  • Have excellent communications skills.

  • Speak and write English fluently. Other European or Central Asian languages are considered an asset.

APPLICATION PROCESS:

In addition to the CV of the person(s) undertaking the work, we also ask that you include the following:

  • Number of person-days they would be ready to provide over a 12-month period.

  • Relevant skills/experience of the person who will actually provide the service.

  • Daily rate, excluding VAT.

  • Commitment to pursue the above objectives, specifying flexibility for the duration of the project and availability for a possible second year of engagement (subject to funding).

  • Willingness to travel in Europe and Central Asia for specific meetings, from within the region.

  • Date on which the consultant could start, as of 4 January 2027.

  • Only applications sent on time and responding to all tendering requirements specified above will be acknowledged. Shortlisted candidates will be notified as soon as possible if their applications are not successful.

FULL TERMS OF REFERENCE:

title: Video Creator (100% remote)
location: USA, Canada, Ireland and UK ONLY
description:
Make videos about brands you love and get paid, no followers required!

We're Marker Video, and we'd love for you to join our platform!👋

Sign up (it's free) and create videos about brands you love across beauty, food & drink, lifestyle, fitness, and travel.

Brands actively buying videos from their real customers (that's you) on Marker include: HelloFresh, Ollie Pets, Camile Thai, Spencer's Gifts and lots more. 

Create videos in your own tone of voice and style with no briefs or scripts from the brands. Authenticity and videos filled with your unique perspective are what brands need and want.

Videos can be reviews, tutorials, first impressions, unboxing videos, vlogs, etc. Just keep them to 30 seconds or less! 

Once your video has been uploaded to Marker, we'll notify the brand, and they can buy and use it for their marketing. 

You’ll get paid $100 for each video you successfully sell, and you can submit as many videos as you like (the more you upload, the more you can earn). 

To sign up, ensure you are: 

  • Based only in the USA, Canada, Ireland or the UK (although you submit videos remotely, we are only Stripe-enabled in select territories, so if you sign up from elsewhere, we won't be able to verify or pay you).

  • Comfortable in front of the camera

  • Fluent in spoken & written English

  • A strong, confident storyteller 

  • Competent in recording, editing and uploading videos for socials 

  • Seriously interested in TikTok & Instagram

  • Passionate about brands and products, and the content on their social channels 

Note that this is not a full-time role. Upload videos as and when you choose, and you’ll be paid for each video you sell on Marker.

Please register via the provided link ONLY; note that any applicants who email us to apply will not be registered on our system.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 
Team Marker
